title: ASSISTENTE COMERCIAL | PRESENCIAL | BELO HORIZONTE
description:
O Assistente Comercial exerce um papel fundamental no relacionamento entre os pacientes e a clínica, atuando de forma estratégica no apoio ao setor comercial e no atendimento. Sua atuação influencia diretamente a experiência do paciente e contribui para a eficiência dos processos administrativos e financeiros da unidade.

Departamento de Atuação:

Comercial

Modelo de Contratação:

CLT

Modo de Contratação:

Presencial (Integralmente)

Horário de Trabalho:

10h às 20h, de segunda a sexta-feira.

Responsabilidades:

  1. Realizar atendimento presencial, telefônico e digital aos pacientes, fornecendo informações sobre serviços, agendamentos e valores.
  2. Apoiar o setor comercial no acompanhamento de propostas, orçamentos e fechamento de tratamentos.
  3. Efetuar lançamentos financeiros no sistema, como registros de pagamentos, recebimentos, emissão de boletos e conciliações básicas.
  4. Acompanhar inadimplências e auxiliar na cobrança amigável, quando necessário.
  5. Manter o sistema atualizado com os dados dos pacientes e informações comerciais.
  6. Organizar e arquivar documentos relacionados a atendimentos, contratos e pagamentos.
  7. Trabalhar em conjunto com a equipe administrativa e financeira para garantir a acuracidade das informações e a fluidez dos processos.

Requisitos Desejáveis:

  • Experiência anterior em atendimento ao paciente, preferencialmente em clínicas médicas ou no setor de serviços.
  • Conhecimento em rotinas administrativas e financeiras.
  • Familiaridade com sistemas CRM (Customer Relationship Management).
  • Boa comunicação, empatia e postura profissional.
  • Organização, atenção aos detalhes e proatividade.

Competências Comportamentais:

  • Foco no paciente e bom relacionamento interpessoal.
  • Responsabilidade e comprometimento com prazos e resultados.
  • Discrição e ética no trato com informações sensíveis.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e resolver problemas com agilidade.

About Experian


A Serasa Experian é a primeira e a maior Datatech do Brasil. Líder em soluções de inteligência para análise de riscos e oportunidades, com foco nas jornadas de crédito, autenticação e prevenção à fraude. Temos 22.000 pessoas operando em 32 países e a cada dia estamos investindo em novas tecnologias, profissionais talentosos e inovação para ajudar todos os clientes a maximizarem cada oportunidade. Com sede corporativa em Dublin, Irlanda, a Experian está listada na Bolsa de Valores de Londres (EXPN) e compõe o índice FTSE 100.


Experience and Skills


O que buscamos em você:

  • Formação superior completa em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Finanças ou áreas correlatas; MBA ou Pós-graduação será considerado diferencial competitivo;
  • Inglês avançado.
  • Experiência sólida em posições de liderança comercial nos canais Wholesale e Retail.
  • Expertise em produtos e serviços financeiros.
  • Visão estratégica aguçada, mentalidade analítica e foco em performance;
  • Capacidade de articulação institucional, negociação de alto nível e gestão de relacionamentos complexos;
  • Vivência com transformação digital, inovação em modelos de negócio e cultura orientada a dados será considerada um diferencial relevante.

Quais serão às suas principais responsabilidades:

  • Atuar como principal estrategista da área comercial, com profundo conhecimento do mercado, comportamento dos clientes e tendências do setor;
  • Definir, implementar e liderar a estratégia comercial da companhia, garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos corporativos e metas de crescimento sustentável;
  • Gerir e expandir a carteira de clientes, promovendo relacionamento de longo prazo e soluções customizadas que agreguem valor;
  • Monitorar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs), assegurando o atingimento de metas de vendas, rentabilidade e satisfação dos clientes;
  • Identificar e liderar oportunidades estratégicas de negócios, incluindo parcerias, fusões e aquisições que acelerem o crescimento da companhia;
  • Inspirar, desenvolver e liderar equipes de alta performance em ambiente desafiador e dinâmico;
  • Atuar em modelo matricial, integrando as metas da área comercial com os objetivos estratégicos das Unidades de Negócio;
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com times especialistas por produto, promovendo sinergia e foco na entrega de valor ao cliente.

Additional Information


Na Serasa Experian, acreditamos que a diversidade é fundamental para um ambiente de trabalho mais saudável e inovador, onde todas as pessoas possam trocar experiências e expressar suas ideias. Por isso, contamos com diversas ações para promover um recrutamento inclusivo e apoiar no desenvolvimento profissional das nossas pessoas. Além disso, temos os nossos grupos de afinidade, criados para empoderar e acolher as pessoas de grupos sub-representados:

ExperianPride (comunidade LGBTQIAPN+), Ubuntu (equidade racial), Women in Experian (equidade de gênero) e aspire (pessoas com deficiência) e Connecting Generations (gerações).

title: Senior Audio Designer
description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

AUDIO

What We Do

We raise the quality level of audio in all Epic game titles and technologies as well as engage with a world-class team to create amazing gaming experiences.

What You'll Do

As part of the Epic Games Audio Team, you’ll collaborate with world-class teams to create amazing gaming experiences and sounds. You’ll also help push the development of audio features and integration for future Unreal audio engine development.

In this role, you will

  • Create and implement audio assets for various key Fortnite assets at a high quality, evaluate audio mix and implementation of audio assets in-game, and adjust according to gameplay needs
  • Coordinate with audio, art and design teams to solve problems
  • Work with UE5 blueprints and data assets to hook up and test audio assets
  • Help with linear trailer or promo video sound edit and mix
  • Manage one or more junior and mid-level audio team members
  • Manage and prioritize assigned tasks, with a focus on achieving goals on schedule
  • Have extensive knowledge of field recording techniques and available sound libraries

What we're looking for

  • Designing, editing, mixing, mastering and implementing content for interactive and linear media
  • Firm grasp of audio programming fundamentals for studio and field recording and strong core competency in at least one major DAW
  • Experience leading a small audio team and supporting them in doing their best and most fulfilling work
  • Strong self-management and organization skills and the ability to work independently
  • Experience with Unreal or Unity editors, including scripting, level editor, animation and linear editors
  • Experience with audio middleware and implementing audio assets into game builds
  • Able to collaborate with diverse teams and disciplines to create effective audio
  • Ability to design and implement audio scripting to achieve desired in-game audio features and dynamic playback
  • Able to troubleshoot audio issues, as well as optimize and meet memory budget and performance requirements across multiple platforms

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers, and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

Epic Games deeply values diverse teams and an inclusive work culture, and we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Learn more about our Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Policy here .

Note to Recruitment Agencies: Epic does not accept any unsolicited resumes or approaches from any unauthorized third party (including recruitment or placement agencies) (i.e., a third party with whom we do not have a negotiated and validly executed agreement). We will not pay any fees to any unauthorized third party. Further details on these matters can be found here .

description:
Descrição da empresa

Com mais de 6 mil funcionários em mais de 20 países, a Statkraft é uma empresa norueguesa, pautada pela ética e transparência. Líder em energia hidrelétrica internacionalmente e maior geradora de energia renovável da Europa, o grupo produz energia hidrelétrica, eólica, solar, a gás e fornece aquecimento urbano.

No Brasil, a sede fica em Florianópolis, Santa Catarina. A empresa controla 26 ativos de geração renovável e, em novembro de 2023, adquiriu a Enerfín, subsidiária da espanhola Elecnor, incluindo nove parques eólicos nos estados do Rio Grande do Sul e Rio Grande do Norte, tornando-se uma das maiores geradoras de energia eólica do país, com mais de 2.2 GW de capacidade instalada.

A Statkraft é pioneira em energia renovável rastreável com garantia de origem no Brasil, certificando a origem da produção com o certificado I-REC, garantindo sustentabilidade.

Descrição da vaga

Procuramos alguém responsável por analisar, controlar e reportar métricas de P&L e risco de mercado. O profissional dará suporte ao front office no monitoramento dos riscos do portfólio de contratos, apoiando na elaboração de produtos estruturados inovadores e facilitando o processo de negócios em colaboração com as áreas de suporte do grupo. As responsabilidades incluem:

  • Avaliar e mensurar riscos de operações estruturadas, coordenando ações com suporte e sugerindo aprovações;
  • Auxiliar na implementação de novos produtos nos sistemas, avaliando impactos e desenhando soluções;
  • Identificar melhorias nas metodologias de risco, considerando legislação e mercado;
  • Sugerir, testar e integrar melhorias nos sistemas de risco;
  • Coordenação de melhorias nos sistemas de risco e gestão de carteira;
  • Atuar como ponte entre a equipe de Risco Global (Oslo) e o risco local, traduzindo nuances do mercado regional;
  • Responsável pelo reporte de performance financeira (P/L) e métricas de risco.

Qualificações

Para esta posição, são necessárias:

  • Graduação em Economia, Engenharia ou áreas afins;
  • Pós-graduação desejável em Finanças ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência sólida em análise de risco de mercado, produtos financeiros e valuation;
  • Conhecimento em Python;
  • Conhecimento sobre regras de comercialização de energia e requisitos regulatórios do setor elétrico brasileiro;
  • Inglês avançado.

Informações adicionais

Na Statkraft, valorizamos pessoas curiosas, interessadas em aprender e melhorar continuamente. Buscamos líderes, ensinadores e colaboradores cooperativos.

O que oferecemos?

Oportunidades de desenvolvimento em vários níveis, incluindo plataformas de aprendizado, programas de crescimento e uma cultura global de inovação, responsabilidade e respeito à diversidade.

Nosso propósito

Contribuir para um planeta mais sustentável, oferecendo energia limpa com ética, integridade e segurança. Fazer parte da Statkraft é inspirar e valorizar a diversidade, promovendo um ambiente de trabalho aberto, transparente e responsável.

Processo seletivo

Avaliamos todos os currículos enviados pelo nosso site. Nosso processo busca candidatos alinhados às demandas da vaga, sem discriminação. Estamos abertos a profissionais talentosos e competentes de todas as origens.

At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage and modernize the mission-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. So why work at Kyndryl? The Role

As a Mainframe Infraestructure Architecture Expert at Kyndryl, you'll have the opportunity to shape the very foundation of the technology that drives our world. Your work will involve developing, testing, and maintaining the software that controls a computer's operating system, hardware, and other systems software. You'll be a master troubleshooter and problem-solver, with the skills to fix even the most complex issues that arise.

Not only will you be responsible for ensuring the security of our computer systems, but you'll also work closely with other IT professionals to design and implement cutting-edge technology that keeps Kyndryl ahead of the curve.

In this role, you'll provide the underlying Mainframe operating system platform programming and DBDC subsystem programming support that forms the backbone of our applications. You'll guide functional objectives on technologies and make use of your expert knowledge to drive solutions to complex problems.

As a leader in this field, you'll also be expected to conduct RCA discussions for the products you work on and provide ongoing technical and operational guidance to lead professional work teams. You may even manage departments on a national or international level, defining objectives and managing resources to ensure the success of your projects.

Your expertise will be crucial in influencing people outside of your department or function, and you'll have the opportunity to directly shape the technology landscape of the world we live in. If you're looking for an exciting and challenging role in the fast-paced world of systems programming, Kyndryl is the place for you!

Your Future at Kyndryl

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major hyperscaler platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

Who You Are

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  • Understanding of Systems and Solutions Architecture
  • Hands-on experience & learning with Data Center technologies and interoperability
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to interact confidently with stakeholders of all levels
  • Excellent English skills
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field

Preferred Skills:

  • Mainframe Modernization
  • Mainframe Integration with Hyperscaler solutions

Being You

Diversity is a whole lot more than what we look like or where we come from, it’s how we think and who we are. We welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. But we’re not doing it single-handily: Our Kyndryl Inclusion Networks are only one of many ways we create a workplace where all Kyndryls can find and provide support and advice.

What You Can Expect

With state-of-the-art resources and Fortune 100 clients, every day is an opportunity to innovate, build new capabilities, new relationships, new processes, and new value. description:
Why join us

TRACTIAN is transforming the industrial world by empowering frontline maintenance workers to achieve more. We’ve fused cutting-edge hardware with innovative software into one powerful platform, disrupting legacy systems and delivering smarter, faster solutions for our clients.

At TRACTIAN, you'll break boundaries, question convention, and collaborate with top talent to drive real change. As a part of our growth-stage startup, you’ll work alongside the founders, shaping the vision, products, and experiences that will define the future of industrial tech.

Area

The Engineering team at Tractian is at the forefront of developing cutting-edge infrastructure, technologies, and products to harness the power of IoT data. Our team of talented Engineers collaborates to build robust systems, innovative solutions, and scalable platforms that drive Tractian's success. We are instrumental in shaping the company's decision-making process, optimizing operational efficiency, and delivering exceptional experiences to our consumers.

What you will do

As a GRC Analyst, you will be responsible for developing and implementing robust governance, risk management, and compliance (GRC) practices within our technology-driven organization. You will play a key role in establishing frameworks and processes that ensure the security, integrity, and regulatory compliance of our technology systems. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to assess risks, implement controls, and drive continuous improvement of our GRC program.

Responsibilities

  • Key Responsibilities:
  • Perform Business Impact Analysis (BIA), mapping processes and identifying RTO and RPO.
  • Conduct the identification, mapping, assessment, and management of both operational and strategic risks across the organization, ensuring compliance with all applicable regulations and internal policies.
  • Keep all the BCP and Disaster Recovery documents up to date.
  • Develop, implement, and update company-wide compliance processes, procedures and rules to ensure alignment with corporate goals, legal requirements, and industry standards.
  • Collaborate with other departments to create and modify operational processes and agreements and execute actions from action plans.
  • Conduct and document regular tests for recovery, continuity plans (disaster recovery exercise, backup & data recovery, etc.) also supporting incident response tests.
  • Implement privacy controls following the company’s governance guidelines and LGPD, GDPR, and CCPA regulations.
  • Support the continuous improvement of compliance with ISO 27001, 27002, 22301 and 22313 standards.
  • Monitor and conduct assessments to ensure the effectiveness of internal controls, also implementing improvements considering audits and assessments reports.
  • Collaborate with multiple departments and headquarters to ensure effective implementation of compliance programs and provide guidance on risk-related matters to leadership.
  • Collaborate to clarify security maturity doubts with stakeholders.
,

Requirements:

  • Background in IT, security, auditing, compliance and/or quality.
  • Experience with BCP-DR based on ISO 22301 and ISO 22313, including development of procedures, execution, and documentation of tests.
  • Experience with audits and assessments of ISO 27001 and SOC 2.
  • Hands-on experience in executing action plans and implementing controls.
  • Knowledge with risk management frameworks (ISO 27005, NIST etc.).
  • Knowledge of privacy laws (LGPD, CCPA, GDPR, etc.)
  • Advanced English proficiency.
,

Would be a plus:

  • Certification related to ISO 27001 and/or privacy (e.g., EXIN or IAPP).
  • Experience in using Business Continuity Management (BCM) tools.
  • Experiences with Vanta, SAT platforms, EDR, MDM, IAM.
  • Other compliance/security certifications.

Global Coffee Controller

COFCO International is a global agri-business with a clear vision, strong values and a positive culture, focused on being a leader in the global grains, oilseeds and sugar supply chains. We provide the food the world needs in a responsible way. Headquartered is Geneva, Switzerland, we are ambitious, with the right structures and culture to meet the world's increasing and changing needs. With 11,000+ people in 35 countries, our global portfolio includes assets across the Americas, Europe, Africa, Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. We trade with over 50 nations, while providing farmers unique direct access to the growing Chinese market.

Job Purpose
The position is responsible for provide leadership for accounting and reporting for Global Coffee division. Ensure the integrity of its financial results (both in local and IFRS standards), following corporate policies and guidelines. Act as business partner with traders and other team members in supporting Coffee Business to achieve its goals, by providing a financial approach to identify, assessing and mitigating risks while contributing to the effectiveness and efficiency of operations. Engage with functions and regional leaders to ensure Coffee business is properly managed and controlled in all countries. This position will report directly to the Global Controller for Softs.

Responsibilities
COFCO International Ltd has a high-profile opportunity for a skilled and team-oriented business controller to join the finance team. This position will directly be responsible for the global business controlling activities of the Coffee division of CIL. Key responsibilities are: ensure the business financial reporting integrity and compliance with the local/IFRS accounting standards and the CIL corporate policies and guidelines; owe the managerial P&L results, ensuring consistency of the reporting of figures with the standards defined by CIL; act as a global finance leader working with the regional teams where Coffee is located to ensure consistency and alignment across the world in terms of process and controls; act as business partner with the traders around the world for all finance related topics to support the business to achieve its strategy goals.

  • Responsible for all financial aspects of the Coffee business transactions in the US.
  • Participate and manage the preparation of financial statements in accordance with IFRS.
  • Perform detailed review of balance sheet and P&L to ensure compliance with Group reporting requirements. Update monthly balance sheet accounts analysis and provide commentary to Senior Management on monthly results.
  • Ensure accuracy of the information in the Accounting Systems consistent with the Trading System.
  • Work closely with market risk to assess the mark-to-market pricing against observable market data. Review and document physical inventory, derivatives and open contract mark-to-market reports.
  • Review calculation of interest & working capital usage for the global business.
  • Review monthly operating expenses and sales, general and administrative expenses, and post accruals as necessary.
  • Act as a leader to ensure the business operates under the pre-defined control framework, assisting leaders to revise control activities and to address and immediately communicate issues.

Business Controlling

  • Develop policies and procedures for the business to be followed in all countries.
  • Prepares and manages Budget Planning process for the global business.
  • Oversight/Responsibility of the daily processes reporting to group: global P&L and Position, ensuring month end accounting P&L results are reconciled to the Trade estimate.
  • Adhoc analysis of significant P&L moves of the business.
  • Provide detailed month-end analysis of the individual trade desks to FP&A and Strategy teams.
  • Work closely with other regions to drive consistency in the group.
  • Manage the internal and external audit for the business which includes coordinating the requirements being pushed to other functional areas.
  • Continuously look to automate and streamline processes and procedures.
  • Work collaboratively with the functional support groups to ensure adequate controls through the trade initiation to cash process and straight through processing to the ledger where possible.
  • Responds to inquiries from a wide variety of sources for the purpose of facilitating communication and/or providing guidance among several parties.

Business Partnering

  • Act independently while being main point of contact for the business on any finance related question.
  • The role is pivotal for answering questions on a day-to-day basis about various topics.
  • Attend constant discussions and forums with Operations and Commercial areas to highlight any issues that may be relevant to the month end.
  • Work closely with business and funtional heads to ensure aligned with global Coffee platform.
  • Maintenance of reporting structure to be aligned with business needs.
  • Act as a strong participant of the softs finance leadership team.

Requirements

  • University degree in Accounting, Finance or Business.
  • CPA is desirable. MBA also desirable.
  • Minimum 15 years of accounting/financial managerial position with a multinational trading company.
  • Proven experience in trading accounting, preferable in Coffee commodity.
  • IFRS knowledge.
  • Preferably with proven international work assignment experience.
  • Experience with SOX is desirable.
  • Ability to integrate the function into the operational and strategic business plans.
  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks concurrently with a sense of urgency.
  • Ability to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Leadership and conflict resolution.
  • Excellent English language skills - verbal and written.

Lead Product Owner

Job Description

Your Job

You’re not the person who will settle for just any role. Neither are we. Because we’re out to create Better Care for a Better World, and that takes a certain kind of person and teams who care about making a difference. Here, you’ll bring your professional expertise, talent, and drive to building and managing our portfolio of iconic, ground-breaking brands. In your role, you’ll help us deliver better care for billions of people around the world. It starts with YOU.

About Us

Huggies. Kleenex. Cottonelle. Scott. Kotex. Poise. Depend. Kimberly-Clark Professional. You already know our legendary brands—and so does the rest of the world. In fact, millions of people use Kimberly-Clark products every day. We know these amazing Kimberly-Clark products wouldn’t exist without talented professionals, like you.

At Kimberly-Clark, you’ll be part of the best team committed to driving innovation, growth and impact. We’re founded on 150 years of market leadership, and we’re always looking for new and better ways to perform – so there’s your open door of opportunity. It’s all here for you at Kimberly-Clark; you just need to log on!

Led by Purpose. Driven by You.

About You

In a landscape dominated by the crucial role of data in shaping business outcomes, Kimberly-Clark stands out by leveraging Snowflake, a premier cloud-based data warehousing solution, to revolutionize the digital customer experience. Our commitment to integrating Snowflake with advanced technologies such as cloud services, AI/ML, and data analytics is pivotal to our strategy.

We are currently seeking a Lead Product Owner for Data and Analytics, who will play a vital role in this transformative journey. This role is not just about leadership; it's an opportunity to be at the forefront of our data and analytics strategy. The chosen candidate will lead the direction, design, and execution of initiatives focused on harnessing the power of Snowflake and other data platforms. Your work will improve transparency, enhance revenue management practices, and boost profitability across our brands and product portfolios.

The ideal candidate is a people leader deeply invested in fostering robust relationships with stakeholders and empowering our team. This person thrives on collaboration and leading teams with a hands-on, empathetic approach, ensuring alignment with our strategic objectives. With a passion for data-driven solutions, this leader will oversee the integration of Snowflake and other advanced technologies, enhancing our capabilities to connect with and serve our clients effectively.

Main responsibilities:

Lead Data and Analytics Initiatives : Spearhead initiatives within the Snowflake environment and other advanced data platforms, collaborating closely with Product Managers and stakeholders. You will focus on defining and prioritizing the product backlog in alignment with our strategic mission to revolutionize the consumer experience through data-driven insights.

• Strategic Product Backlog Management : Manage the Data and Analytics product backlog with precision, ensuring that each item aligns with our long-term vision and immediate business needs. Balance new developments, operational tasks, and bug resolutions to deliver continuous value, driving our mission of enhancing transparency and profitability across brands.

• Release Planning and Execution : Develop and maintain release plans for data and analytics enhancements, incorporating financial costs and Total Cost of Ownership (TCO). Work with Product Managers and delivery teams to set realistic release goals, aligning them with our strategic mission to deliver innovative, market-leading solutions.

• Collaborative Product Development : Engage continuously with the Scrum team and subject matter experts to refine backlog items, ensuring all developments align with our strategic mission and stakeholder expectations. Provide necessary support during sprint sessions to maintain focus on delivering strategic objectives.

• Sprint Management and Execution : Define clear priorities and sprint goals, focused on crucial data and analytics projects that advance our mission. Offer ongoing support to overcome obstacles and ensure smooth workflow, maintaining alignment with our overarching business goals.

• Quality Assurance and Stakeholder Engagement : Evaluate and maintain the integrity of all deliverables within the Snowflake environment, ensuring they meet our standards and mission. Actively participate in agile events, championing stakeholder needs and facilitating effective communication across all levels of the organization.

• Cross-functional collaboration : Coordinate resources across various departments for meticulous planning and execution of product backlog items. Engage in successful sprint reviews, user acceptance testing, and deployment of new features, ensuring each step aligns with our mission to provide exceptional customer-centric solutions.

• Cultural and Team Development: Promote a culture of continuous learning and improvement within the Data and Analytics team. Advocate for professional development and knowledge exchange, building a high-performing team that is dedicated to our mission of delivering innovative solutions.

Key Qualifications and Experiences:

Mandatory:

  • Bachelor’s degree required.

  • Fluent English

  • 7+ years’ experience with database development

  • 5+ years’ experience in leading agile teams

  • Stakeholder management: experience and demonstratable aptitude towards Product team leadership

  • Strategic Problem Solving and Analytical Thinking

  • Proactive personality with a drive to deliver results

  • Analytics product development experience: 5+ years crafting and delivering analytics reporting and/or AI/ML solutions for a large, multicultural matrixed organization

  • Experience with Data Quality process and implementation for products (e.g. Test Planning, quality monitoring, issue resolution)

Nice to have

  • Development experience in Snowflake DB platform

  • Development experience in Power BI

  • Experience with AD group security and implementation in platforms like Snowflake and Power BI

title: Incident Response Engineer
description:
As a member of the ETMSA team at Crypto.com , you will be integral to responding to and managing cybersecurity threats and incidents throughout their lifecycle – from Preparation to Identification, Containment, Eradication, Recovery, and Lessons Learned – collaborating with a global team of incident responders.

You will apply your comprehensive skills in cyber defense, digital forensics, log analysis, and intrusion analysis to address security incidents across our endpoints, network, and cloud infrastructure. In this role, you will be responsible for prevention, detection, response, and remediation activities, ensuring that information assets and technologies are adequately protected by leveraging various technologies such as Next-Generation Firewalls (NGFW), Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), Intrusion Detection/Prevention Systems (IDS/IPS), Data Loss Prevention (DLP), and more.

You will also leverage your collaboration and communication skills to work effectively with all relevant stakeholders in multicultural and global environments.

Responsibilities

- Report to Director to facilitate all phases in the incident response lifecycle

- Be involved in various incident prevention projects to improve Security posture

Preparation:

- Understand different regulatory and compliance requirements like critical time to report, escalation flows, etc.

- Take part in self-assessment exercises like Tabletop Exercises, Attack Simulations, Red/Purple Team exercises to make sure the incident response process is working smoothly

Develop incident response runbooks, playbooks and SOPs with reference to different regulatory requirements

- Evaluate the incident response readiness of different layers - people, process, technology

Detection & Analysis:

- Respond to the cyber security incidents escalated from various channels including the 24/7 SOC team.

- Respond to cyber security incidents in compliance with the local authority / regulatory requirements.

- Assess the risk, impact and scope of the identified security threats

- Perform deep-dive incident analysis of various data sources by analysing and investigating security related logs against medium-term threats and IOCs

Containment, Eradication and Recovery:

- Communicate with the stakeholders and provide guidance, recommendations to contain and eradicate the security incident

- Participate in root cause analysis using forensic and other custom tools to identify any sources of compromise and/or malicious activities taking place.

- Document and present investigative findings for high profile events and other incidents of interest.

Post incident activities:

- Provide lessons learnt meeting to the stakeholders

- Lead and keep track on the follow-up activities

- Document the incident in the case management system and provide incident reports

Always ready to jump in, in the event of security incidents.

Requirements

  • At least 5 years experience in the Cyber Security industry
  • Strong technical and analytical skills
  • Familiar with the cyber security incident response process
  • Familiarity with AI tools and their application in automating security tasks and processes.
  • Hands-on experience on performing incident response activities
  • Have scripting experience like Bash, PowerShell, Python, Go, etc, and the ability to use these skills to aid in responding to incidents involving Windows, Linux, macOS, as well as cloud environment
  • Have knowledge of cybersecurity tools and software like NGFW, EDR, IDS/IPS, EDR, DLP, SIEM, other log management platforms, etc.
  • Be familiar with the MITRE ATT&CK Framework and/or Cyber Kill Chain
  • Be passionate on exploring new technologies and having creative initiative to boost the team capabilities
  • Holders of security related certifications is a plus (e.g.Azure , AWS, CISSP, GCIH, GCIA, GCFA, GNFA, GREM, or other equivalent)
  • Awareness of regulatory and compliance requirements like GDPR, MAS, PSD2 etc is a plus.

Preferably

  • Fast learner with can do attitude and ready to get the hands dirty
  • A strong team player who can collaborate with compassion
  • Passionate to learn and willing to put in the extra effort
  • Understand the concept of ownership and accountability coupled with sense of urgency and prioritisation
  • Confidence in handling incidents and managing relevant senior and technical stakeholders
  • Possess business acumen/mindset (not only technical) when making critical decisions

As Discord’s Head of Public Policy for Brazil and Latin America, you will be responsible for building trust and finding common ground with policymakers, regulators, and other stakeholders in Brasilia and national capitals across Latin America.   1. Introduce Discord to government policymakers and civil society stakeholders in key markets across the region, including educating decision-makers on our founding vision, our products, and our investments in privacy and safety;
  2. Develop and execute a multi-year government advocacy strategy that maps the interests of Discord users and the company’s business goals to the evolving legal and regulatory landscape in those key markets;
  3. Identify emerging trends in the regulation of online communications services and build action plans responsive to these trends in coordination with our Legal, Product, and Communications teams;
  4. Advocate for Discord’s position on key legislative and regulatory initiatives that will impact our users and our business, balancing direct advocacy with effective leverage from coalitions and associations;
  5. Provide context and support for the company’s responses to regulator inquiries;
  6. Promote employee awareness and invite employee engagement on our public policy strategy and priorities;
  7. Engage in public policy coalitions with peer companies and civil society organizations;

  9. Manage the company’s government affairs consultants and advisors in Latin America.

  1. Sustained (7+ years) professional success at the highest levels of government and/or in strategic public policy advocacy
  2. Experience developing and executing public policy advocacy campaigns in Brazil, with experience in other key markets (Mexico, Argentina, Chile) in the region a plus
  3. Insight on the policymaking process in key markets throughout the region
  4. Commitment to Discord’s mission to be the place where everyone can find belonging before, during and after playing games together online
  5. Willingness to travel as necessary within the region, with occasional travel to the U.S. as required

Bonus Points

  1. Work experience on technology policy initiatives such as online safety, privacy, cybersecurity, or content moderation, especially in the online gaming space
  2. Ability to translate complex technical information into clear, compelling narratives for non-technical audiences
  3. Leadership experience with a civil society organization and/or tech company
  4. Success building trust and consensus across stakeholders with different perspectives and priorities

Why Discord?

Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. A disability is a condition that substantially limits one or more of your “major life activities.” If you have or have ever had such a condition, you are a person with a disability. Disabilities include, but are not limited to:

title: Account Executive
description:
Tactiq is a rapidly growing global Series A SaaS startup headquartered in Sydney, that uses generative AI to extract actionable knowledge from conversations. Our mission is to transform how teams capture and utilize conversational insights to drive productivity and innovation. Over 600,000 users across 10,000 organizations in the US, EU, and LatAm, including Fortune 500 and ASX50 companies, love us, and we're ready to take the South American market to the net new level together.

We're seeking a driven and experienced self-starter Account Executive in Brazil, Sao Paolo, preferably, to spearhead our further expansion across Brazil and South America. As our first dedicated sales hire in Brazil, you'll be instrumental in establishing Tactiq as the go-to solution for mid-corporate and enterprise teams seeking to maximize the value of their meetings. Working hand-in-hand with a ‘playing coach’ Sales Manager, you will also be supported by a Customer Success Manager in your time zone, a sales engineer, and a powerful marketing team to ensure your efforts are converted into success in a controllable way.

What You'll Do:

  • Drive the Full Sales Cycle: From initial contact to closing deals, you'll own the sales process for enterprise and mid-corporate accounts.
  • Identify and Qualify Leads: Leverage multiple outbound channels and prospecting skills to identify key decision-makers and qualify high-potential leads using ICP metrics.
  • Manage Pipeline: Maintain an accurate balanced CRM pipeline. Provide confident data-driven forecasts and iteratively develop key account plans.
  • Conduct Product Demonstrations: Showcase the power of Tactiq through compelling product demos tailored to the specific needs of each prospect.
  • Build Relationships: Develop and nurture strong, trust-based relationships with key stakeholders and product champions, becoming a trusted advisor on meeting productivity.
  • Close Deals: Consistently meet and exceed sales targets, driving ARR and expansion growth for Tactiq in the Brazilian and South American market.
  • Full-stack Sales Professional: You are a subject matter expert in technology sales. Having had a wide-ranging experience, you use professional concepts and company objectives to resolve multiple tasks and issues in creative and effective ways.
  • Hunter Mentality (a cliche line that works ;)))): You are a self-starter who thrives on the thrill of the chase and isn't afraid to roll up your sleeves and get your hands dirty.
  • Multi-lingual: Fluency in Portuguese and English is mandatory. Knowledge of Spanish is highly advantageous as well.
  • Multi-tenant Sales Targeting: You own a history of selling into various customer audiences (not just technical or business). You confidently address different customer queries and use cases through multiple angles of a product.
  • Enterprise/Mid-Corporate Sales Experience: Proven track record of success selling SaaS solutions to enterprise and mid-corporate clients.
  • Working knowledge of PLG: You know product-led sales and can easily distinguish a PQA from a PQL to execute an efficient lead-generation process.
  • Great Visual Thinker: You project a holistic picture of account development journey over 12-18 months, from initial activation to company-wide coverage.
  • SaaS/AI/Cloud expertise: You confidently operate knowledge about LLMs, SSO, SAML, SOC2 and feel comfortable around technical and regulative concept landscape.
  • Strong Qualifier: Professional in qualifying IN and OUT to ensure efforts are applied to the tangible and closable opportunities only.
  • Deal Engineer: You construct non-standard commercial solutions to fit customer economics and provide long-term commercial benefits.
  • Sales tech-savvy: Strong knowledge of outreach tools (Apollo, Luna.ai, Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator), CRM power user (Hubspot) and enrichment platforms (Skrapp.io, Rocketreach).
  • Solid Storytelling Skills: You put customer problems first and give compelling reasons to transfer from As Is to To Be state.
  • Results-Oriented: Driven by a desire to achieve and exceed targets, with a focus on delivering measurable results.

What is the Tactiq style?

  • Concise, make-it-happen approach.
  • A dynamic collaborative culture that values rapid feedback, empowerment, and openness.
  • Fast decision-making based on sanity-check, common sense, and universal business laws to ensure all decisions get us closer to the strategic business goals.
  • Work-life balance. Being a global team empowered by various cultural backgrounds, we get the importance of life outside work to make every working hour count.
  • We aim to run from ideation to shipment in hours or days.

Why would you join?

  • Be a Pioneer: Capitalize on the existing strong position and shape the future of Tactiq in the Latin American, with a direct impact on our fast-paced growth and success. Design your territory plans and GTM strategies that will get you to the results.
  • Uncapped Potential: Enjoy a competitive salary, commission structure, and opportunities for professional development.
  • Innovative Culture: Work alongside a talented and passionate team that's dedicated to pushing the boundaries of productivity.
  • Make a Difference: Help teams worldwide unlock the power of productivity. Act as the voice of the customer, providing valuable feedback to our product team to ensure Tactiq continues to meet the evolving needs of our users.
  • Remote Flexibility: Work from anywhere in Brazil (Sao Paolo preferred), actively collaborating with our Australian and global teams.
  • A pathway into AI: Take the next step in your career to learn and harness the power of AI technology.
  • Standard equipment includes MacBooks, with the flexibility to provide whatever tools you need to excel in your role.

  • Define systems, tools, and business requirements for varied Customer Success projects

title: Strategy & Operations Analyst
description:
Company Overview


Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).

What you'll do

We are looking for a Strategy & Operations Analyst to join our Sales Analytics team. In this role, you will focus on building scalable data models, launching and maintaining Tableau dashboards, and providing actionable sales insights that drive performance and strategic decision-making. You will also play a key role in supporting the creation and maintenance of decks for executive presentations. Additionally, you will be responsible for pulling data for these decks and running ad-hoc queries to address evolving business needs. Working closely with both Sales and Sales Operations teams, you'll ensure data infrastructure is optimized and reporting processes are efficient, helping to drive the overall success of the Sales organization.

This position is an individual contributor role reporting to Senior Manager of Sales Analytics.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain scalable, high-performance data models in Snowflake that support sales reporting and analytics
  • Ensure the accuracy and consistency of data across systems, automating and optimizing data pipelines where necessary
  • Support the continuous improvement of data architecture to ensure that the analytics platform is scalable and reliable
  • Identify and resolve issues related to data reporting and dashboard performance
  • Develop and maintain dashboards
  • Design, implement, and manage Tableau dashboards to track sales performance, key performance indicators, and key business metrics for Sales Leadership
  • Collaborate with Sales and Operations Teams to define reporting needs and deliver actionable insights via Tableau and other visualization tools
  • Provide ongoing maintenance and enhancements to Tableau dashboards, ensuring they remain up-to-date with business requirements
  • Ensure proper data governance, consistency, and quality across Sales analytics processes
  • Assist in defining and monitoring Sales metrics, helping drive better decision-making through actionable insights
  • Run ad-hoc queries to gather data and provide insights in response to business requests and evolving needs
  • Communicate complex data insights clearly to non-technical partners, providing recommendations for action
  • Assist in creating and updating decks for executive presentations, communicating data insights and performance metrics
  • Pull and analyze data from various sources to support the creation of decks, ensuring insights are accurate and relevant
  • Collaborate with partners to ensure insights are effectively presented in a clear and visually compelling manner

Techfins são empresas de tecnologia que querem utilizar sua força de desenvolvimento para distribuir e democratizar o acesso aos melhores produtos financeiros.

ECOSEC

What We Do

Our ECOSEC team provides a safer experience for Epic's users. We work across multiple products and services to improve technology and craft transparent policies so our players and users can have positive experiences on our platforms.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is looking for a Backend Security Engineer focused on Asset Integrity to protect sensitive game assets from unintended information disclosure. Your efforts will be critical to the success of Fortnite and the many creators who depend on it. The ideal candidate will be well-versed in backend development and have prior experience developing security features. This is an incredible opportunity to contribute to the next generation of Epic’s game development tools.

In this role, you will

  • Directly contribute code and be a code owner for multiple services and code bases
  • Collaborate with the Fortnite, Unreal Engine, and Epic Games Store teams to understand the security implications of existing and upcoming features, proposing changes if appropriate
  • Work with internal and external UEFN development teams, including well-known brands, to address concerns about asset integrity and information disclosure
  • Investigate technical root causes of unintended information disclosure incidents
  • Proactively seek out components in Fortnite backend services that create asset integrity risks, then clearly communicate the problem and recommended solution
  • Build and improve internal tooling at scale to protect the Epic creator ecosystem
  • Handle various real-time issues that may arise on online services and platforms

What we're looking for

  • 3+ years of software engineering experience, with experience in backend development for games
  • Expert knowledge in one or more of the following programming languages: C++, Java, Go, or TypeScript
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems and design patterns
  • Strong knowledge of AWS/Cloud infrastructure including code-as-infrastructure (e.g. Terraform)
  • Experience building & managing distributed systems, designing APIs, and deploying services (e.g. Kubernetes)
  • Experience working with data analytics to solve, prevent, or monitor for problems
  • Knowledge and/or experience mitigating security vulnerabilities in sandboxes / virtual machines and potential mitigation strategies
  • Experience building or working with CI/CD environments
  • Experience working with building and deploying container images

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers, and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Overview Of Position
The Sr. IP Network Engineer is an individual contributor with advanced background in IP Network Engineering design, implementation and operation.

Overview Of Position
The Sr. IP Network Engineer is an individual contributor with advanced background in IP Network Engineering design, implementation and operation.
The primary objective of the Sr. IP Engineer within the Edge Network Engineering team is to properly identify customer requirements and establish and deploy a solution which meets the customer’s needs and expectations. This will require disciplined compliance with change management best practices while working both independently and with cross-functional teams; this role will have opportunities to coach team members on complex technical issues, interface with other engineering and support groups internally, and engage with customer IT personnel on complex network/system performance and troubleshooting efforts.
This Sr. IP engineer position provides customer facing global IP network design and implementation, hardware selection and configuration standardization as it relates to network routing protocol, switching and security methodology. As part of the Edge Network Engineering team, the role also includes Tier 4 escalations from the global support organization as well as providing pre-sales technical consultation alongside Sales and Solutions/Systems Engineering teams.
What you will do:

  • Build and maintain customer’s IP network infrastructure within Speedcast Edge network
  • Enforcing Cyber Security policies and hardening of non-core managed network devices
  • Contributes to the development of customer-facing solutions in coordination with Sales/Sales Engineering, Product/Edge Network Engineering teams to ensure optimal solution and supportability
  • Ensure that all engineering parameters and configurations meet the client’s requirements and are being fulfilled on a timely basis
  • Provide 4th level technical escalation support by providing end-to-end subject matter expertise
  • Design and implement customer functional networks such as LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, QoS, and Security/VPN
  • Collaborate with other Engineers around the globe in the design and deployment of new services and/or enhancements/changes to existing network services
  • Advise and recommend technical solutions that will enhance, increase levels of redundancy, survivability and add flexibility to existing global Speedcast systems, network and VSAT Platforms
  • Coach and mentor team members on complex technical issues to deliver the highest level of service to our customers
  • Assist in strengthening IP expertise within the Edge Network Engineering and Customer Support Teams
  • Assist in the development or improvements of network operational best practices and processes to customer network performance, capacity and scalability
  • Ensures that appropriate action is taken to anticipate, investigate and resolve problems in systems and services. Coordinates the implementation of agreed remedies and preventative measures. Analyzes patterns and trends
  • Controls, updates and distributes new and revised quality, configuration and services standards, including technical changes, and maintains documentation
What we need from you:
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering (BSEE preferred) but will consider candidates with the right combination of relevant work experience or degrees in related fields
  • Must have at least 7 years of network engineering design and operation experience utilizing various networking equipment from Cisco, Palo Alto, Versa Networks, Juniper
  • Must have proven experience in the application of network design, development and implementation techniques in communications systems that involve a variety of hardware and software suites
  • End-to-end knowledge of various access technologies and networking protocols.
  • CCIE certification preferred but may be substituted with equivalent experience and knowledge of routing, switching and Security/VPN
  • Advanced level knowledge and hands on working experience of routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, RIPv2), MPLS and SD-WAN
  • Advanced level knowledge and hands on working experience in designing and implementing complex QoS in a Cisco network environment.
  • Extensive experience with Network Security and VPN design and implementation utilizing Cisco and Palo Alto
  • Extensive experience with WAN optimization technology platforms
  • Experience with Newtec Dialog and iDirect VSAT Platform is a plus.
  • Experience with various VSAT antenna systems such as Seatel, Cobham, Intellian, Sailor, Virgin Technologies, Orbit and Kymeta is a plus
  • Experience with various wireless broadband in offshore communication such as LTE, Inmarsat FleetBroadband/BGAN, Iridium
  • Experience with various NMS and ITSM such as Solarwinds, DataMiner and ServiceNow
  • Experience with network packet analyzer tools such as Wireshark, NetFlow or equivalent and bandwidth measurement tool such iPerf or equivalent tool
  • Able to communicate effectively via written and verbal communications.
  • Excellent problem solver, flexible and able to accommodate changing priorities and directions
  • Must be able to interact effectively within all levels of the company
  • Ability to effectively manage multiple projects and function with minimal supervision
  • Research and analytical skills with the ability to collect access and report factual data and present logical conclusions

A AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. Trabalha em parceria com atores da cooperação internacional, setor público e iniciativa privada. Vinculada à Fundação AVSI, ONG italiana atuante no Brasil desde os anos 1980, tem como missão promover o protagonismo das pessoas em seu desenvolvimento, de suas famílias e comunidades. Implementa projetos sociais com base em uma metodologia de desenvolvimento integral e solidário, voltada à autonomia e à dignidade humana.

Oprojeto Acolhidos por meio do trabalho promove a integração de pessoas refugiadas e migrantes venezuelanas por meio de ações de qualificação, empregabilidade e articulação com o setor privado. Santa Catarina é o estado que mais recebe famílias interiorizadas e concentra a maior parte das parcerias com empresas no Brasil. Esse ecossistema local de acolhimento é dinâmico, mas demanda uma articulação mais estruturada para garantir o sucesso da integração.

DESCRIÇÃO RESUMIDA DO CARGO:

O(a) Oficial de Operações é responsável por apoiar na coordenação da estratégia de interiorização, assegurando o acolhimento adequado dos migrantes e refugiados venezuelanos nas cidades de destino e promovendo sua integração socioeconômica. Atua diretamente na supervisão de serviços de apoio psicossocial, organização logística, elaboração de documentos e monitoramento das ações nos territórios que recebem venezuelanos interiorizados.

Apoio à estratégia de interiorização:

Apoiar a Coordenação no processo de interiorização, reunindo e organizando todas as informações e ações necessárias para garantir o bom recebimento e acompanhamento das famílias interiorizadas.

Articular com a Coordenação do projeto em Boa Vista as etapas prévias e posteriores à interiorização dos beneficiários.

Logística e suporte às famílias interiorizadas:

Elaborar pedidos de requisição de mobiliários, cestas básicas, kits de higiene e outros insumos, conforme a composição familiar e as necessidades identificadas em campo.

Organizar e acompanhar a chegada dos beneficiários nas cidades de acolhida, assegurando a entrega de itens essenciais e o suporte necessário à instalação das famílias.

Gestão do suporte psicossocial:

Identificar, entrevistar e selecionar consultores psicossociais locais que apoiarão os beneficiários por períodos de 3 a 4 meses.

Acompanhar a atuação desses profissionais e garantir a entrega de relatórios de acompanhamento conforme os padrões acordados.

Monitorar vigência de contratos e apoiar nos trâmites administrativos relacionados ao pagamento das consultorias.

Monitoramento e produção de informações:

Realizar visitas de monitoramento para acompanhar o processo de integração dos beneficiários nas cidades de destino.

Apoiar a coleta e sistematização de dados sobre os beneficiários interiorizados, contribuindo para o monitoramento de indicadores do projeto.

Elaborar relatórios técnicos, descritivos e de acompanhamento das ações realizadas no território.

Apoiar na elaboração, revisão e organização de contratos de prestação de serviço, termos de referência, pedidos de compras e outros documentos administrativos relacionados às atividades sob sua responsabilidade.

Manter a organização e atualização dos arquivos e documentos físicos e digitais de sua área.

Contribuir para a prestação de contas e sistematização de boas práticas junto à equipe local e nacional.

Mobilidade e articulação:

Atuar em articulação com a equipe de Chapecó e os escritórios de Boa Vista e Brasília, assegurando alinhamento institucional.

title: Senior UI Artist
description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ART

What We Do

Push your artistic talent to the limit on a team of world-class environment, character and concept artists who strive to innovate and inspire.

What You'll Do

As a Senior UI Artist, you will collaborate with UX designers to design features and UX/UI systems by generating high-fidelity mockups, prototypes, design systems, and style guides. You will assist the UI Technical Designers and UI Engineers to build out the designs into rapid prototypes and shippable UI to players. In this role, you will have the ability to take wireframes and bring them to life while improving the UX with visuals. You will also implement final art in Unreal Editor using UMG, animations, materials, etc.

In this role, you will

  • Work collaboratively with UX Design, Tech UI Design, and Engineering to create AAA-quality UI experiences
  • Actively participate in the creation and implementation of design systems, game menus, HUD elements, Iconography, UI materials and shaders, UI animation, and motion design
  • Create new material effects, implement basic logic in blueprints, and/or create 2D effects
  • Contribute to shipping high-quality features on time
  • Collaborate with the greater UXUI Department to ensure consistency and quality are maintained across the project
  • Execute at a high-quality bar, work autonomously, and tackle complex features and systems
  • Work in Photoshop, Illustrator, and/or Figma to create concept UI art

What we’re looking for

  • You have 7+ years of experience working collaboratively to see complex UI features through to completion across multiple platforms (mobile, pc, consoles)
  • You have 7+ years of experience working in Agile environments and on multi-disciplinary teams
  • Excellent visual design skills with a strong portfolio
  • You are skilled with Figma, Adobe Suite, or other comparable software
  • A strong portfolio of work showcasing your skills and your process
  • Experience with UI Art implementation, in Unreal Engine (UMG) or equivalent game engine
  • Experience with building UI materials & shaders for game engines, or equivalent 3d packages and FX tools; motion design & UI animation, preferably for games or interaction design
  • You have the ability to see features through to completion and rapidly modify work as information changes
  • You have a passion for making and playing games and have a strong sense of player empathy
  • You are a proactive individual who naturally leans into owning outcomes and is able to deal with ambiguity well and adapt to changes of plan quickly

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

Our intent is to cover all things that are medically necessary and improve the quality of life. We pay 100% of the premiums for both you and your dependents. Our coverage includes Medical, Dental, a Vision HRA, Long Term Disability, Life Insurance & a 401k with competitive match. We also offer a robust mental well-being program through Modern Health, which provides free therapy and coaching for employees & dependents. Throughout the year we celebrate our employees with events and company-wide paid breaks. We offer unlimited PTO and sick time and recognize individuals for 7 years of employment with a paid sabbatical.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

Epic Games deeply values diverse teams and an inclusive work culture, and we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Learn more about our Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Policy here .

Note to Recruitment Agencies: Epic does not accept any unsolicited resumes or approaches from any unauthorized third party (including recruitment or placement agencies) (i.e., a third party with whom we do not have a negotiated and validly executed agreement). We will not pay any fees to any unauthorized third party. Further details on these matters can be found here .

description:
Do you enjoy using science to drive change in the world?

Do you have an exceptional eye for accuracy and detail?

About our Team

The Lancet Regional Health – Americas is an open access journal, part of the Lancet's global initiative to advocate for health-care quality and access in all regions of the world. We are an international team, handling high-quality research, reviews, commissions and commentaries to drive thought leadership across all areas of clinical and global public health pertaining to the WHO Americas region. We build close relationships with clinical and research communities to ensure we offer a personalised service to authors while publishing exciting, interesting, and thought-provoking content. We also undertake considerable community engagement and political activities to leverage change.

About the Role

As a Senior Editor, you will work alongside other Senior Editors, a Deputy Editor, and the Editor-in-Chief in all aspects of the organisation and preparation of the journal. You will take ownership of overseeing submissions and performing quality peer review to ensure we publish high-quality content. You will build international relationships with experts in the community to disseminate and discuss practice-changing results from the field.

At the Lancet we are deeply committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, and inclusive environment. In our pursuit of excellence, we recognise the strength in varied perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. As part of our ongoing efforts to enhance the diversity of our editorial team, we encourage applications from individuals who bring unique skills, backgrounds, and perspectives to the role.

This is a full-time, fixed term position.

Responsibilities

· Identifying experts to act as peer reviewers on selected submissions

· Commissioning and handling special project content

· Write editorials, organise peer review of research articles and reviews, and conduct webinars and podcasts with authors and key opinion leaders.

· Develop and maintain relationships with medical research communities to solicit high-quality research, particularly clinical trials, for the journal.

· Attending conferences and other events, to represent the journal, to identify suitable topics and authors, and to keep up-to-date with current developments in medical research

· Collaborating with colleagues to improve internal policies and processes

· Liaising with other editors, authors, and production teams to perfect papers for publication

Requirements

· A medical degree in a relevant discipline or a higher degree (PhD) in a relevant discipline (eg, biomedical science, public health, global health)

· Have experience in a relevant field or experience in the wider development community

Para chegar lá, investimos acima de tudo nas nossas pessoas, que formam um time incrível e comprometido com esse grande objetivo. E aí, vem com a gente?

Nossa cultura

Nossos valores são a base para tudo que fazemos! Aqui na Unico, agimos sem fronteiras; impactamos sem rodeios; somos transparentes mesmo em situações difíceis; resilientes e adaptáveis para evoluir; fazemos a coisa certa do jeito certo e somos ousados ao liderar a construção do futuro. Nosso ambiente de trabalho é descontraído e colaborativo, cheio de oportunidades de aprendizado e possibilidades para você desenvolver sua carreira com autonomia e apoio de líderes e colegas.

Como membro do time de product marketing da unico, você será responsável por liderar as estratégias de comunicação do produto, trabalhando junto ao time de produto e de marketing, desenhando planos de go-to-market, participando das cerimônias do squad, e orquestrando a execução junto aos times de vendas. Também será esperado que você participe com o time de gestão de produto e de design das definições de visão do produto, trazendo direcionamentos com base nas necessidades dos nossos clientes, nas demandas de mercado e na solicitação e execução de pesquisas.


Principais responsabilidades:
  • Desenhar, orquestrar e implementar as estratégias de posicionamento do produto: análises de diferenciais, comunicação e mensagens de produto, precificação, entre outros, traduzindo a voz do cliente e necessidades do mercado em um plano de go-to-market efetivo e alinhado com as áreas de vendas, produto, canais, marketing, pesquisa e clientes;
  • Participar da construção e priorização do roadmap do produto junto do time de product management, trazendo insights para o desenvolvimento de produto que nos permitirão alcançar mais casos de uso e ter mais aderência a necessidades do mercado;

  • Gerir programas de MVP com clientes e parceiros, ajudando a definir métricas de sucesso e entregando as mensagens corretas;

  • Trabalhar de forma efetiva com times altamente multidisciplinares, principalmente com o time de produto, sendo capaz de comunicar objetivos do produto e captar necessidades de melhorias, validando e priorizando hipóteses e táticas;
  • Gerir stakeholders e tomar decisões sobre futuro do posicionamento do produto e GTM de maneira independente;
  • Ser criativo(a) e aberto(a) às mudanças. O ambiente é dinâmico, estamos crescendo muito rápido.
Requisitos da Vaga:
  • 8+ anos de experiência na área de marketing de produto/portfólio, ou marketing de campo (field marketing), preferencialmente em um ramo de tecnologia;Experiência de marketing B2B;

  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de estratégias e campanhas de marketing;

  • Ser apaixonado(a) por tecnologia, por vendas, por contar histórias, por entender dinâmicas de mercado e oportunidades;
Competências necessárias:
  • Pensamento estratégico: ser orientado por uma visão macro da empresa e conseguir colaborar para o atingimento de resultados;
  • Trabalhar bem com autonomia;
  • Comunicação: capacidade de falar e escrever em alto padrão, capacidade de defender uma ideia de forma concisa, convincente e estratégica. Ficar confortável em apresentar para grandes públicos;
  • Poder analítico: de diversas fontes de informações, conseguir pinçar e transformar dados em insights e direcionamento de negócios. Ter familiaridade com análise de dados, pesquisas e entrevista;
  • Centrado no cliente / consumidor: conseguir colocar as necessidades das pessoas em primeiro lugar e buscar a solução de problemas nesse sentido;
  • Orientado a vendas: capacidade de transformar produto em valor percebido e ser direcionado por resultados de vendas e adoção de produto;
  • Perfil curioso pelo que está acontecendo no mundo (concorrentes, tendências, tecnologia);
  • Colaborativo: capacidade de se conectar com pessoas para entender seus problemas e compartilhar tomada de decisões.

Conheça os benefícios de se tornar um Ser Unico

Benefício flexível: R$ 1.500 ,00 por mês que podem ser distribuídos nas modalidades VA/VR, Cultura, Mobilidade e Flex Férias;

Diversidade & Inclusão

Na Unico estamos empenhados em construir uma cultura inclusiva, valorizando em todas as nossas posições a candidatura de todas as pessoas, independentemente de sua etnia, gênero, orientação sexual, política, religião, deficiência, naturalidade ou qualquer outro tipo de característica.

description:
Recycled Plastics Markets Reporter

About the job:

We are looking for a Recycled Plastics Markets Reporter to join our Content team in the Americas.

You will work closely with a group of analysts and editors to assess prices on a daily or weekly basis, produce market intelligence and in-depth analytical content, break exclusive news, investigate market developments, and explain what this means for our customers.

The role will provide exposure and opportunities to engage with industry contacts. You will contribute to raising the profile of ICIS as well as build and showcase your market expertise by attending and speaking at industry events, conferences and at client sessions.

You will collaborate closely with other business functions, contribute ideas and carry out work on new coverage areas and methodology developments aimed at meeting customer needs and expanding the ICIS business.

In this role, you will be encouraged to be your best, to learn and to grow. You will become a recognized expert in your field which can open doors to a wealth of diverse opportunities within ICIS and across the commodities sector at a vital time of global transition.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Cover a portfolio of recycled PET, PE and PP markets in Latin Americas and produce weekly content to regular and timely deadlines with the highest level of accuracy and balance.
  2. Write insightful news and analysis explaining price trends and market developments for the region.
  3. Proactively chase stories across your portfolio.
  4. Build and nurture a wide network of industry contacts.
  5. Develop and showcase expertise on petrochemical markets.
  6. Report on complex topics in an engaging and timely manner through the use of data visualizations.
  7. Coordinate with colleagues regionally and globally to tell a cohesive story of market conditions.
  8. Transform analytical concepts into easily-understandable written word.
  9. All other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

  1. An inquisitive mind.
  2. Ability to write and communicate with clarity.
  3. Knowledge of or interest in market economics.
  4. High level of numerical accuracy.
  5. Excellent inter-personal skills.
  6. Experience of working with Excel/Excel-based business tools.
  7. Ability to work as part of a team in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  8. Passionate, curious, high-performing, accountable team players.
  9. Bachelor’s/master’s degree in chemistry, plastics engineering.
  10. Experience in plastics industry with knowledge of recycled plastic producers and applications desired.
  11. Experience in purchasing or selling plastics desired.
  12. Basic analytical understanding.
  13. Fluent written and spoken English and Portuguese.

  • Internal Expertise: Be a source of insight and strategic advice for internal teams. You’ll act as the go-to expert for your speaker tracks and industries.
Skills and abilities we're looking for
  • You’re consistently booking high-quality, relevant speakers for Centre Stage and beyond.
  • You aim to confirm at least 4 A-list speakers per year across your content verticals.
  • You stay ahead of industry shifts and consistently maintain a strong research pipeline with timely, strategic outreach.
  • You communicate clearly and proactively with your manager, particularly around pipeline challenges.
  • You demonstrate strong editorial judgment , creating engaging formats and talk titles that resonate with our global audience.
  • You are a reliable team player who collaborates effectively across departments.

Who you are
  • Ideally, 2–4 years of experience in production, content, editorial, or events (or adjacent industries)
  • Strong interest in tech, innovation, entrepreneurship, or media
  • Confident communicator with experience engaging high-profile individuals and companies
  • Exceptional organisational and writing skills
  • Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English (written and spoken)
  • Experience with tools like CRMs, Google Suite, and other productivity platforms is a plus

- Hybrid-working model open to all employees.
