title: Security Software Engineer
description:
Join or sign in to find your next job

Join to apply for the Security Software Engineer role at Canonical

1 week ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Security Software Engineer role at Canonical

This is a general track for security-focused engineering in every team at Canonical, across all levels of seniority. Apply here if you are already an exceptional security-focused software engineer.
Most product engineering teams at Canonical include one or two spaces for dedicated security-oriented software engineers. Their role is to challenge the entire team to think more deeply about security. They contribute to the product as engineers too, but their primary focus is to improve security through state of the art practices - from table-top threat model exercises to architecture reviews, from extended security testing with fuzzers and static analysis tools to external security analyst liaison.
We also build a number of products that are entirely motivated by security technology and requirements, such as our AppArmor kernel investments and our hardening, compliance and certification toolkits for Ubuntu.
As the publisher of Ubuntu we also handle long-term security response and hardening for the entire operating system and open source universe. Working with tens of thousands of upstreams means that we need to be fluent in every major programming language, and design, build and adopt sophisticated tools that enable us to work at scale and speed with confidence.
These roles encompass all aspects of product security, including feature development, vulnerability response, proactive security and open source community participation. All security roles interact closely with many of the other Canonical engineering and development teams, Canonical customers and our partners across the open source community.
Location: We have open roles for security specialist software engineers in every timezone.
What you'll do
Security roles might tackle any of the following:

  • Define, implement and document new security features
  • Lead security-oriented thinking in a product engineering team
  • Analyze, fix, and test vulnerabilities in Canonical and open source Software
  • Contribute to Ubuntu and upstream projects to benefit the community
  • Audit and analyze source code for vulnerabilities
  • Integrate new tools in our security infrastructure, pipelines and processes
  • Achieve and retain various security certifications
  • Extend and enhance Linux cryptographic components - specifically with modules such as OpenSSL/Libgcrypt - with the features and functionality required for country-specific compliance such as FIPS and CC certification
  • Work with external partners to develop CIS benchmarks
  • Design and develop hardening automation for Ubuntu
  • Monitor the security industry for new developments
  • Develop, test and maintain new software capabilities
  • Provide guidance and support to other engineering teams
What we are looking for in you
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • A thorough understanding of the common categories of security vulnerabilities
  • Modern engineering techniques to find and fix them
  • Familiarity with open source development tools and methodologies
  • Skill in one or more of C, Python, Go, Rust, Java, Ruby or PHP
  • Experience as a security champion
  • Experience driving security within a wider SDLC process
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Passion, thoughtfulness, and self-motivation
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each
Optional skills we also value
  • Clear and effective communication with the team and Ubuntu community members
  • Experience working with Linux Kernel
  • Security Certification experience and knowledge in FIPS and/or CC
  • Experience with OVAL (Open Vulnerability Assessment Language)
  • Knowledge of and familiarity with low-level Linux cryptography APIs
  • Demonstrated high learning ability
  • Performance engineering experience
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. description:

Join to apply for the Cloud Engineering Manager role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring an Engineering Manager ...
This role is an opportunity for a technologist with a passion for Linux and Cloud technologies to build a career with Canonical and drive the success with those leveraging Ubuntu and open source products. If you have an affinity for open source development and a passion for technology, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.
The BootStack team designs, builds, and operates modern distributed systems on private infrastructure for customers. From Kubernetes to OpenStack and everything in-between, you'll be working with the latest technology in a fast-paced engineering environment. As a Cloud Engineering Manager for the BootStack team, you will be responsible for managing the engineers that oversee day-to-day Managed Service of customer environments, including customer service management, managed services operations and consistent product improvement engineering. Collaboration with customers, product engineering, and operations is critical to success.
Location: This is a globally remote role.
The role entails

  • Manage a growing engineering team to optimise the quality and velocity of both development and operations
  • Identify and measure team health indicators
  • Implement disciplined engineering and operations processes
  • Represent the BootStack team with respect to stakeholders, customers, and external teams
  • Ensure proper team focus on priorities, milestones, and deliverables
  • Work to meet service level agreements with customer deployments around the globe
  • Deliver quality managed services in a consistent, timely manner
What we are looking for in you
  • Bachelors (or equivalent) education in a technology field
  • Proven track record of professional experience of either software delivery using Python, Go, C, C++, Java, or similar and/or managing operations teams
  • Proven experience with OpenStack
  • Demonstrated strong commitment to testing methodologies and maintainable code quality
  • Experience with Linux system administration, Ubuntu/Debian a plus
  • Strong communication and cooperation skills
  • Experience with agile software development methodologies
  • Experience working in and managing distributed teams
  • Technical aptitude for understanding complex distributed systems
  • Experience with cloud topologies and technologies
  • Travel to team and company events and customer meetings, roughly 20% or less
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:

1 week ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Senior Operations Specialist role at HDR

At HDR, our employee-owners are fully engaged in creating a welcoming environment where each of us is valued and respected, a place where everyone is empowered to bring their authentic selves and novel ideas to work every day. As we foster a culture of inclusion throughout our company and within our communities, we constantly ask ourselves: What is our impact on the world?
Watch Our Story:' and every role throughout our organization makes a difference in our ability to change the world for the better. Read further to learn how you could help make great things possible not only in your community, but around the world.
HDR is looking for an energetic, hard working problem solver to become a full time Senior Operations Specialist to work on both municipal and industrial water treatment facilities. If you are someone who is looking to work on a variety of treatment technologies for multiple treatment plants, then this position will be for you. This individual will work on water treatment projects that can range from small municipalities to some of the most iconic in the United States. Our engineering staff rely heavily upon our Operations Specialist staff to create solutions with better reliability and improved operability for our clients.
You will not only be a part of our East Region team, but will be a key member of HDR’s nationwide Operations Team. This team is made up of other experienced maintenance and operations experts, and coordinate to share best practices, experience, and opportunities to utilize every team member’s unique expertise. We currently have extensive project backlog in throughout the United States, so you will be able to immediately contribute to our success.
The work location will be at the HDR office closest to your current location. Please check the HDR website nearest to you.
About Us
For over 100 years, HDR has specialized in engineering, architecture, environmental and construction services. We provide solutions to thousands of partners, from small local utilities to the largest global companies. HDR has nearly 13,000 employee owners worldwide and ENR ranked in the top 10 of Water design firms, Water Treatment and Desalination design firms, and Wastewater design firms. Our Water Business Group has over 2,000 employee owners, with over 500 in our Eastern Region.
At HDR, we know work isn’t only about who you work for; it’s also about what you do and how you do it. Led by the strength of our values and a culture shaped by employee ownership, we network with each other, build on each other’s contributions, and collaborate together to make great things possible. When you join HDR, we give you license to do the same. We help you take charge of your career, giving you multiple growth opportunities along the way.
Primary Responsibilities

  • Support HDR project leaders at the local, state, and regional level on water treatment projects requiring input from Operations Specialists.
  • Review drawings for operability review and HazOps analysis with an eye for what it takes to successfully operate a variety of treatment processes successfully.
  • Manage operations and maintenance projects with both municipal and industrial clients. It will involve client interfacing, regulatory reporting, as well as personnel, subcontractor, and maintenance management.
  • Develop startup and commissioning plans and host workshops to share those ideas with client’s contractors and operators to ensure the plan will work for each specific plant.
  • Perform startup and commissioning of new water treatment facilities. This work involves you playing a key role in working alongside contractors and engineers to ensure the new equipment functions correctly before handing it over to the operations and maintenance staff.
  • Perform formal and informal training to help our clients’ treatment plants operate as well as they can operate.
  • Participate in the testing of facilities to ensure they are ready for startup and after startup they meet the capacity requirements of the design.
  • Perform condition assessment and asset management tasks on water and wastewater facilities, using state of the art evaluation tools to efficiently capture the information and opinions that you generate.
  • Perform operational or maintenance troubleshooting and evaluations on municipal and industrial water facilities.
Work will involve a base of projects in the southern portion of the central United States, but will also include projects in several sites across the country. It provides the opportunity to work on a variety of new and innovative projects, and provides a career path that has more growth than typical utility organizations.
This job may require 30 to 40% travel, more is possible. Weekend travel is normally not required.
Strongly Preferred Qualifications
  • Minimum 10 years field experience in troubleshooting mechanical, electrical, and instrumentation equipment at water treatment facilities and/or resolving water treatment process problems. Additional construction experience is a plus.
  • High level water treatment operator license or professional engineering license.
  • Ability to interpret engineering plans and specifications.
  • Microsoft Office product and computerized maintenance and management systems experience required.
  • An attitude and commitment to being an active participant of our employee-owned culture is a must
  • Valid driver’s license.
Required Qualifications
  • High School diploma or equivalent
  • Microsoft Office product experience
  • General background-related experience
  • An attitude and commitment to being an active participant of our employee-owned culture is a must
What We Believe
HDR is our company. Together, we build on each other's life experiences and perspectives to make great things possible every day. This shapes our collaborative culture, encourages organizational trust and connects us closer to the clients and communities we serve.
Our Commitment
As employee owners, we all have a role in creating an inclusive environment where each of us is welcomed, valued, respected and empowered to bring our authentic selves to work every day.
Our eight Employee Network Groups (Asian Pacific, Black, Hispanic/Latino(a), LGBTQ+, People with Disabilities, Veterans, Women, Young Professionals) help create a sense of belonging and foster a supportive environment where everyone is empowered to engage and contribute. title: Security Software Engineer
description:
1 week ago Be among the first 25 applicants

This is a general track for security-focused engineering in every team at Canonical, across all levels of seniority. Apply here if you are already an exceptional security-focused software engineer.
Most product engineering teams at Canonical include one or two spaces for dedicated security-oriented software engineers. Their role is to challenge the entire team to think more deeply about security. They contribute to the product as engineers too, but their primary focus is to improve security through state of the art practices - from table-top threat model exercises to architecture reviews, from extended security testing with fuzzers and static analysis tools to external security analyst liaison.
We also build a number of products that are entirely motivated by security technology and requirements, such as our AppArmor kernel investments and our hardening, compliance and certification toolkits for Ubuntu.
As the publisher of Ubuntu we also handle long-term security response and hardening for the entire operating system and open source universe. Working with tens of thousands of upstreams means that we need to be fluent in every major programming language, and design, build and adopt sophisticated tools that enable us to work at scale and speed with confidence.
These roles encompass all aspects of product security, including feature development, vulnerability response, proactive security and open source community participation. All security roles interact closely with many of the other Canonical engineering and development teams, Canonical customers and our partners across the open source community.
Location: We have open roles for security specialist software engineers in every timezone.
What you'll do
Security roles might tackle any of the following:

  • Define, implement and document new security features
  • Lead security-oriented thinking in a product engineering team
  • Analyze, fix, and test vulnerabilities in Canonical and open source Software
  • Contribute to Ubuntu and upstream projects to benefit the community
  • Audit and analyze source code for vulnerabilities
  • Integrate new tools in our security infrastructure, pipelines and processes
  • Achieve and retain various security certifications
  • Extend and enhance Linux cryptographic components - specifically with modules such as OpenSSL/Libgcrypt - with the features and functionality required for country-specific compliance such as FIPS and CC certification
  • Work with external partners to develop CIS benchmarks
  • Design and develop hardening automation for Ubuntu
  • Monitor the security industry for new developments
  • Develop, test and maintain new software capabilities
  • Provide guidance and support to other engineering teams
What we are looking for in you
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • A thorough understanding of the common categories of security vulnerabilities
  • Modern engineering techniques to find and fix them
  • Familiarity with open source development tools and methodologies
  • Skill in one or more of C, Python, Go, Rust, Java, Ruby or PHP
  • Experience as a security champion
  • Experience driving security within a wider SDLC process
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Passion, thoughtfulness, and self-motivation
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. If you have an affinity for open source development and a passion for technology, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.
The BootStack team designs, builds, and operates modern distributed systems on private infrastructure for customers. From Kubernetes to OpenStack and everything in-between, you'll be working with the latest technology in a fast-paced engineering environment. As a Cloud Engineering Manager for the BootStack team, you will be responsible for managing the engineers that oversee day-to-day Managed Service of customer environments, including customer service management, managed services operations and consistent product improvement engineering. Collaboration with customers, product engineering, and operations is critical to success.
Location: This is a globally remote role.
The role entails

  • Manage a growing engineering team to optimise the quality and velocity of both development and operations
  • Identify and measure team health indicators
  • Implement disciplined engineering and operations processes
  • Represent the BootStack team with respect to stakeholders, customers, and external teams
  • Ensure proper team focus on priorities, milestones, and deliverables
  • Work to meet service level agreements with customer deployments around the globe
  • Deliver quality managed services in a consistent, timely manner
What we are looking for in you
  • Bachelors (or equivalent) education in a technology field
  • Proven track record of professional experience of either software delivery using Python, Go, C, C++, Java, or similar and/or managing operations teams
  • Proven experience with OpenStack
  • Demonstrated strong commitment to testing methodologies and maintainable code quality
  • Experience with Linux system administration, Ubuntu/Debian a plus
  • Strong communication and cooperation skills
  • Experience with agile software development methodologies
  • Experience working in and managing distributed teams
  • Technical aptitude for understanding complex distributed systems
  • Experience with cloud topologies and technologies
  • Travel to team and company events and customer meetings, roughly 20% or less

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

title: Product Owner - Integrações
description:
O profissional irá atuar no time de Integrações na Torre de Segmento Varejo e Distribuição, tendo como principal missão ser a ponte estratégica entre times de negócio e times técnicos, assegurando alinhamento de prioridades, clareza de escopo e entrega contínua de valor nas demandas que conectam diferentes sistemas, definição de roadmap e acompanhamento de resultados.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as squads de negócio para identificar, priorizar e detalhar demandas de integração internas e externas;
  • Garantir clareza nos requisitos, representando o time de negócio nos projetos de integração;
  • Criar, organizar e refinar o backlog de tarefas relacionadas às integrações, assegurando alinhamento com os objetivos estratégicos da empresa;
  • Facilitar a comunicação e colaboração entre stakeholders e o time de desenvolvimento, promovendo sinergia entre as áreas;
  • Monitorar o progresso das entregas, identificando possíveis riscos e propondo soluções;
  • Monitorar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) do produto;
  • Garantir a documentação robusta de processos;
  • Prover o direcionamento de produtos criando e mantendo atualizada a visão do mesmo e o roadmap juntamente com o Product Manager e Tribe Lead;
  • Planejar as entregas, criando, refinando e atualizando o backlog do produto e priorizando os itens de maior relevância, gerenciando a expectativa dos stakeholders;
  • Validar as entregas realizadas pelo Dev Team, garantindo que todas as definições e os critérios de aceite foram atendidos;
  • Divulgar atualizações e liberações do produto para clientes internos e externos, através dos canais oficiais estabelecidos pela TOTVS;
  • Realizar a gestão do produto, por meio de coleta de feedbacks internos e externos e da análise de indicadores de produto e operação;
  • Efetuar a negociação com outros Product Owners e Product Managers sobre prazos e assuntos de negócio para entregas conjuntas entre squad;

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação superior completa nas áreas de Tecnologia;
  • Habilidade em traduzir demandas de negócio em especificações técnicas claras;
  • Experiência em projetos de integração de sistemas;
  • Experiência prévia como Product Owner ou Coordenador/Gestor de sistemas;
  • Excelente capacidade de comunicação, priorização e negociação com áreas correlatas;
  • Vivência com gestão de backlog, priorização de demandas e definição de roadmap de produto;
  • Experiência com frameworks ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e condução de cerimônias ágeis;
  • Gestão de Indicadores e habilidade na definição e acompanhamento de KPIs de produto;
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com foco em documentação clara e estruturada;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de gestão de produtos e projetos (ex: Jira, Confluence, Trello);
  • Conhecimentos em API REST, SOAP e Postman e/ou Insomnia;
  • Conhecimento básico de banco de dados, desenvolvimento e arquitetura de software.

Requisitos desejáveis

  • Vivência anterior como Tech Lead, Product Owner ou funções correlatas;
  • Universidade em Rede TOTVS, uma universidade Corporativa com conteúdos e certificações gratuitos para cada TOTVER;
  • Programa +Saudáveis, que cuida de cada TOTVER com assessoria e ações voltadas para o bem estar em corpo, mente e finanças pessoais;
  • Programa +Vantagens, a maior rede de descontos da América Latina, exclusivos para TOTVERS;
  • Programa + Cuidado, programa de apoio pessoal para TOTVERS e familiares, com orientações em diversas especialidades como: psicologia, serviço social, pet consultoria...
  • Einstein Conecta, benefício de orientação médica online pelos médicos do Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein, totalmente gratuito;
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico;
  • Vale refeição e/ou alimentação;
  • Vale transporte e fretados em algumas estações do metrô;
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida;
  • Espaço de lactário;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Auxílio creche;
  • Previdência privada;
  • Escritório que estimula a criatividade e produtividade com ambientes para lanches, salas de jogos, mesas de bilhar e poltronas para relaxar;

Sobre a empresa

Se você é uma pessoa que é gente boa, gosta de aprender e é apaixonada por resultados, você está no lugar certo! Como maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, queremos construir um ecossistema cada vez mais forte, com pessoas que gostem de inovar e acreditem na colaboração para fazer a diferença!

Se desejar, pode incluir também informações adicionais de benefícios e cultura, mas o essencial foi mantido e organizado para maior clareza e leitura fluida.

Job Title: Sr. Manager- NPI Engineering Sourcing

Job Description
Job Title: Sr. Manager- NPI Engineering Sourcing
Job Overview
As Sr. Manager- NPI Engineering Sourcing at Nextracker, you will play a critical role in driving the sourcing strategy and execution for new Electrical and Power conversion product introductions. You will manage procurement activities related to new product BOMs and first factory setup, ensuring alignment with business objectives and critical timelines.
Key Responsibilities

  • Sourcing Strategy Development: Lead the development and execution of sourcing strategies for new product initiatives, ensuring timely and cost-effective solutions. Own and maintain up to date CBOM at all times of development.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Collaborate with engineering, quality assurance, and sourcing teams to align sourcing activities with product launch schedules, driving successful new product introductions.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Provide consistent project updates to senior management and other stakeholders regarding sourcing strategies, project progress, and any necessary adjustments.
  • Risk Management: Identify potential risks associated with new product sourcing in collaboration with sourcing managers, and develop robust mitigation strategies to address these risks.
  • Project Scheduling Coordination: Develop detailed project schedules for procurement milestones that align with overall program schedules and cost targets, ensuring that project teams work in conjunction with category strategies.
  • Procurement Activity Oversight: Manage quotes, purchase orders, deliveries, and all procurement activities to support project needs effectively.
  • Performance Monitoring: Monitor project progress, make timely adjustments as needed, and measure performance to identify areas for improvement.
  • Milestone Monitoring: Monitor key milestones, ensuring adherence to identified timelines and deliverables for key objectives within assigned programs.
  • Coordination with Contract Manufacturers: Coordinate the delivery with contract manufacturers (CMs) of products through the NX NPI process to ensure on-time “turn” for material procurement, product assembly, product testing, field testing, and Production Part Approval Process (PPAP).
Qualifications & Requirements
Education & Experience:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Business, or a related field (Master’s degree or MBA preferred).
  • 15+ years of experience in sourcing, supply chain, procurement, or supplier management within solar, renewable energy, electronics, or high-tech manufacturing.
  • Proven track record in New Product Introduction (NPI) sourcing, supplier development, and cost negotiation.
Technical & Industry Knowledge
  • Deep understanding of global supply chain dynamics, supplier qualification, and commodity management.
  • Experience with mechanical and electrical components, raw materials, and contract manufacturing in the solar, energy, or hardware sectors.
  • Knowledge of PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) processes and familiarity with manufacturing techniques like stamping, casting, and welding.
Skills & Competencies
  • Strong negotiation and supplier relationship management skills to drive cost savings and ensure supply chain reliability.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment and collaborate with engineering, operations, and finance teams.
  • Experience with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, or similar) and procurement tools.
  • Strong data analysis, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience working with Asian, European, and North American suppliers.
  • Familiarity with sustainability initiatives and compliance in the renewable energy sector.
  • Prior leadership experience in a hardware technology company, solar tracker, or related industry.
At Nextracker, we are leading in the energy transition, providing the most comprehensive portfolio of intelligent solar tracker and software solutions for solar power plants, as well as strategic services to capture the full value of solar power plants for our customers. Our talented worldwide teams are transforming PV plant performance every day with smart technology, data monitoring and analysis services.
For us at Nextracker, sustainability is not just a word. It's a core part of our business, values and our operations. Our sustainability efforts are based on five cornerstones: People, Community, Environment, Innovation, and Integrity. We are creative, collaborative and passionate problem-solvers from diverse backgrounds, driven by our shared mission to provide smart solar and software solutions for our customers and to mitigate climate change for future generations.
Culture is our Passion

  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft applications (Excel, Word and PowerPoint and working knowledge of financial planning systems such as Hyperion
  • Excellent knowledge of forecasting techniques
  • Strong accounting background, especially revenue/expense recognition rule with extensive experience in financial forecasting and modelling
  • Great data visualization and presentation skills to provide recommendations based on insight
  • Demonstrated proficiency in time and project management skills; ability to manage multiple projects across critical yet often fluctuating deadlines – and with sometimes minimal and/or ambiguous input from stakeholders.

Join to apply for the Líder Regional de Talent Acquisition, LatAm role at Edelman

Edelman is a voice synonymous with trust, reimagining a future where the currency of communication is action. Our culture thrives on three promises: boldness is possibility, empathy is progress, and curiosity is momentum.
At Edelman, we understand diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging (DEIB) transform our colleagues, our company, our clients, and our communities. Estamos procurando uma pessoa com forte expertise para atuar como Liderança Regional de Talent Acquisition (TA) para a América Latina, integrando nosso time global de liderança de Recrutamento e Seleção / Talent Acquisition.
Esta é uma oportunidade estratégica para desenvolver e implementar a abordagem de TA na região LATAM, em alinhamento com a estratégia global, dentro de uma organização com estrutura matricial internacional.
A posição lidera uma equipe responsável pelos processos de recrutamento em vários países (Argentina, Brasil, Colômbia, México e Peru), com contribuição direta para os objetivos globais de atração e seleção de talentos.
Somos uma agência global de comunicação, responsável por construir, promover e proteger marcas e reputações de vários clientes. Entregamos trabalhos de qualidade, enquanto colaborando com uma rede de profissionais dedicados, em um ambiente colaborativo, diverso e focado em desenvolver o que há de melhor em cada um!
Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolvimento de Estratégia: Desenvolver e implementar uma estratégia abrangente de aquisição de talentos para a região LATAM, alinhada ao modelo global de talent acquisition. Essa estratégia deve incluir melhores práticas, inovação, iniciativas de DEI (Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão) e planejamento de força de trabalho.
  • Recrutamento Executivo: Conduzir processos completos de recrutamento de cargos de liderança sênior na região LATAM, com foco em identificar, atrair e construir relacionamentos de longo prazo com talentos-chave.
  • Gestão de Mudanças: Liderar iniciativas de gestão de mudanças para se adaptar às condições de mercado, novas tecnologias e tendências do setor. Implementar soluções inovadoras para aprimorar a experiência e a eficiência do processo de recrutamento.
  • Transformação: Liderar e apoiar esforços de transformação na área de talent acquisition, garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos organizacionais. Impulsionar melhorias contínuas em processos, ferramentas e metodologias.
  • Abordagem Baseada em Dados: Utilizar dados e análises para embasar decisões, acompanhar indicadores-chave de desempenho e identificar oportunidades de melhoria nos processos de atração de talentos.
  • Engajamento com Stakeholders: Colaborar com stakeholders regionais e globais para entender as necessidades de talentos e garantir uma experiência fluida e positiva para candidatos e gestores de contratação.
  • Especialização em Marca Empregadora: Conduzir com sucesso ações de fortalecimento da marca empregadora na região LATAM. Desenvolver e executar estratégias para posicionar a organização como empregadora de escolha, mantendo uma imagem forte e consistente em diferentes países.
  • Gestão de Equipe Regional: Liderar e orientar uma equipe geograficamente distribuída, demonstrando sensibilidade às dinâmicas culturais locais. Promover colaboração, oferecer suporte e garantir o cumprimento das metas de recrutamento.

  • Graduação completa em Psicologia, Administração, Recursos Humanos, Comunicação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida em Talent Acquisition - profissional precisa ter o perfil especialista e não generalista;
  • Experiência em liderança de equipes multiculturais e distribuídas geograficamente.
  • Vivência anterior em ambientes globais.
  • Histórico de condução de recrutamento executivo (C-level e diretoria), porém também fará posições de todos os outros níveis.

  • Inglês fluente (obrigatório) – uso constante em reportes e alinhamentos globais.

  • Experiência com arquiteturas em nuvem (AWS, Azure ou Google Cloud).

Description
CRA I - Sponsor dedicated - Brazil Home Based
Syneos Health is a leading fully integrated biopharmaceutical solutions organization built to accelerate customer success. We translate unique clinical, medical affairs and commercial insights into outcomes to address modern market realities.
Our Clinical Development model brings the customer and the patient to the center of everything that we do. We are continuously looking for ways to simplify and streamline our work to not only make Syneos Health easier to work with, but to make us easier to work for.
Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to accelerate the delivery of therapies, because we are passionate to change lives.
Discover what our 29,000 employees, across 110 countries already know:
WORK HERE MATTERS EVERYWHERE
Why Syneos Health

  • We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
  • We are committed to our Total Self culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Our Total Self culture is what unites us globally, and we are dedicated to taking care of our people.
  • We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because when we bring together diversity of thoughts, backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives – we’re able to create a place where everyone feels like they belong.
Job Responsibilities
  • Performs site qualification, site initiation, interim monitoring, site management activities and close-out visits (performed on-site or remotely) ensuring regulatory, ICH-GCP and/or Good Pharmacoepidemiological Practices (GPP) and protocol compliance. Uses judgment and experience to evaluate overall performance of site and site staff and to provide recommendations regarding site-specific actions; immediately communicates/escalates serious issues to the project team and with guidance develops action plans. Maintains a working knowledge of ICH/GCP Guidelines or other applicable guidance, relevant regulations, and company SOPs/processes.
  • Verifies the process of obtaining informed consent has been adequately performed and documented for each subject/patient, as required/appropriate. Demonstrates diligence in protecting the confidentiality of each subject/patient. Assesses factors that might affect subject/patient’s safety and clinical data integrity at an investigator/physician site such as protocol deviation/violations and pharmacovigilance issues.
  • For the Clinical Monitoring/Site Management Plan (CMP/SMP): o Assesses site processes o Conducts Source Document Review of appropriate site source documents and medical records o Verifies required clinical data enteredin the case report form (CRF) is accurate and complete o Applies query resolution techniques remotely and on site, and provides guidance to site staff as necessary, driving query resolution to closure within agreed timelines o Utilizes available hardware and software to support the effective conduct of the clinical project data review and capture o Verifies site compliance with electronic data capture requirements
  • May perform investigational product (IP) inventory, reconciliation and reviews storage and security. Verifies the IP has been dispensed and administered to subjects/patients according to the protocol. Verifies issues or risks associated with blinded or randomized information related to IP. Applies knowledge of GCP/local regulations and organizational procedures to ensure IP is appropriately (re)labelled, imported and released/returned.
  • Routinely reviews the Investigator Site File (ISF) for accuracy, timeliness and completeness. Reconciles contents of the ISF with the Trial Master File (TMF). Ensures the investigator/physician site is aware of the requirement of archiving essential documents in accordance with local guidelines and regulations.
  • Documents activities via confirmation letters, follow-up letters, trip reports, communication logs, and other required project documents as per SOPs and Clinical Monitoring Plan/Site Management Plan. Supports subject/patient recruitment, retention and awareness strategies. Enters data into tracking systems as required to track all observations, ongoing status and assigned action items to resolution.
  • For assigned activities, understands project scope, budgets, and timelines; manages site-level activities / communication to ensure project objectives, deliverables and timelines are met. Must be able to quickly adapt, with the oversight of the Lead CRA, to changing priorities to achieve goals / targets.
  • May act as primary liaison with project site personnel, or in collaboration with another CRA or Central Monitoring Associate (CMA). Ensures all assigned sites and project-specific site team members are trained and compliant with applicable requirements.
  • Prepares for and attends Investigator Meetings and/or sponsor face to face meetings. Participates in global clinical monitoring/project staff meetings (inclusive of Sponsor representation, as applicable) and attends clinical training sessions according to the project specific requirements.
  • Provides guidance at the site and project level towards audit readiness standards and supports preparation for audit and required follow-up actions.
  • For Real World Late Phase, the CRA I will use the business card title of Site Management Associate I. Additional responsibilities include: o Site support throughout the study lifecycle from site identification through close-out o Knowledge of local requirements for real world late phase study designs o Chart Abstraction activities and data collection o Collaboration with Sponsor affiliates, medical science liaisons and local country staff
Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree or RN in a related field or equivalent combination of education, training and experience
  • Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice/ICH Guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements
  • Must demonstrate good computer skills and be able to embrace new technologies
  • Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to manage required travel of up to 75% on a regular basis
Get to know Syneos Health
Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.
No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

Summary
Roles within Clinical Monitoring/CRA at the P20 level are responsible for ensuring that clinical research studies are conducted in accordance with widely accepted clinical practices. This includes both on-site and remote monitoring, as well as the development of tools, procedures, and processes to ensure quality monitoring. These roles involve individual contributions in a professional or technical discipline, with the possibility of managing two or fewer employees. The majority of time is spent contributing to the design, implementation, or delivery of processes, programs, and policies, using knowledge and skills typically acquired through advanced education. Impact and Contribution Roles within Clinical Monitoring/CRA at the P20 level play a crucial part in the success of clinical research studies. By ensuring that trials are conducted according to established clinical practices, these roles help maintain the integrity and quality of the research. The development of monitoring tools, procedures, and processes contributes to the overall efficiency and effectiveness of the clinical research program. These roles also support the professional growth of lower-level professionals and the management of processes and programs, thereby contributing to the organization's mission of advancing medical knowledge and improving patient outcomes. Core Focus
  • Conducting on-site and remote monitoring of clinical research studies to ensure compliance with widely accepted clinical practices
  • Developing and implementing tools, procedures, and processes to ensure quality monitoring
  • Contributing to the design, implementation, and delivery of processes, programs, and policies
  • Supporting the professional growth of lower-level professionals and managing processes and programs

description:
O BEES é nosso aplicativo B2B, voltado a pequenos e médios varejistas do mundo todo. Usando o BEES, comerciantes e donos de bares de todo o mundo podem fazer pedidos para abastecer seus estoques, programar entregas, acessar dados do próprio negócio e muito mais.

No BEES, nosso sonho é um só: fazer nossas pessoas, nossos usuários e nossos parceiros prosperarem!

A AB InBev é a cervejaria líder global e uma das 5 principais empresas de produtos de consumo do mundo. Com mais de 500 marcas no portfólio, somos número um em muitos dos principais mercados de cerveja.

No Brasil, somos responsáveis por marcas como Brahma, Skol, Antarctica e Guaraná e temos muito orgulho em tornar o mundo um lugar com mais razões para brindar!

Sobre a vaga

Estamos buscando um(a) Data Analytics Manager para liderar nosso time de analistas de dados, sendo referência técnica, guiando e apoiando o time na entrega de soluções analíticas que impactam diretamente a nossa operação global. Se você gosta de dados, tem perfil analítico, espírito de liderança e gosta de transformar dados em insights acionáveis, essa vaga é pra você!

  • Gerenciar e liderar um time de alta performance de analistas de dados, sendo referência técnica e promovendo mentorias e desenvolvimento do time.
  • Gerenciar um time de aproximadamente 5 a 10 pessoas, dependendo da alocação dos projetos.
  • Realizar revisões técnicas para garantir as melhores práticas, qualidade dos produtos de dados, além de recomendar as melhores fontes, modelos e métodos para cada caso de uso.
  • Atuar junto a times de produto, engenharia e estratégia comercial para construir uma estratégia unificada, orientada por dados.
  • Apoiar na priorização das demandas do time, junto aos stakeholders e data product managers, considerando impacto no negócio, esforço e prazos.
  • Conciliar atividades de liderança com desenvolvimento prático de produtos de dados, métricas e dashboards para geração de valor ao negócio.
  • Guiar a estratégia de negócio, fornecendo insights de performance atual e identificando oportunidades de crescimento a partir de análises avançadas, modelos estatísticos e preditivos.
  • Desenvolver datasets e schemas que integrem dados de múltiplas fontes (bancos internos, ferramentas de análise, fontes externas e não estruturadas).
  • Produzir narrativas e histórias com dados que direcionem ações, desenvolvendo visualizações e dashboards no Power BI.
  • Garantir o uso de métodos analíticos adequados para resolver problemas complexos.
  • Demonstrar domínio de modelos de dados, estruturas e boas práticas de governança de dados, apoiando os times de plataforma e engenharia nas melhores decisões técnicas.
  • Comunicar conceitos técnicos e análises complexas de forma clara e efetiva para stakeholders e liderança, inclusive não técnica.

O que você precisa ter

  • Formação em Sistemas de Informação, Ciência de Dados, Engenharia, Análise de Dados ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia em gestão técnica de times de Data Analytics, além de sólida experiência em análise de dados e data science.
  • Inglês avançado (mandatório) para atuar com times globais. Espanhol é um diferencial.
  • Experiência com soluções em nuvem como Snowflake, Databricks, Redshift, BigQuery ou Teradata.
  • Domínio de SQL, Power BI (DAX) e ferramentas de visualização. Tableau e Mode são diferenciais.
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em linguagens de programação como Python, PySpark e SQL. R será considerado um diferencial.
  • Forte capacidade analítica, visão crítica, raciocínio lógico e domínio de métodos estatísticos aplicados a negócios.
  • Experiência em levantamento de requisitos complexos, entendimento das necessidades do negócio e transformação desses requisitos em soluções de dados.
  • Experiência na análise de grandes volumes de dados, buscando insights, identificando gaps e inconsistências.
  • Conhecimento do ciclo de desenvolvimento de software e metodologias ágeis.
  • Vivência em utilização de dados transacionais e comportamentais para entender impactos no negócio e comportamento dos usuários, com foco em geração de ROI.

title: Lead Character Artist
description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ART

What We Do

Push your artistic talent to the limit on a team of world-class environment, character and concept artists who strive to innovate and inspire.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is searching for an experienced Lead Character Artist to join our Fortnite Battle Royale team. In this position, you will lead and manage a team of Character Artists working on major initiatives within Fortnite. You will work directly with the art and design departments to help our team create and quickly iterate on exciting, purposeful characters that look amazing. You should have a combination of strong creative/visual aesthetics, excellent design skills, leadership experience, and a clear rendering style in modeling characters. You should be able to demonstrate that you can think outside the box and translate an awesome gameplay experience into an awesome visual experience as well as have experience creating stylized to semi-stylized characters.

In this role, you will

  • Create characters and enemies based on direction from the project Art Director and input from the game design team
  • Based on visual direction from the Art Director, collaborate on the visual style and ensure our designs are of the Epic quality bar
  • Help Epic push the visual envelope by creating stunning and inspiring characters
  • Create and iterate unique and stunning designs within a determined production schedule
  • Partner with other departments such as Character Design or Concept Art team, to ensure the models work within the project workflow

What we're looking for

  • Ability to help mentor and coach a growing team of artists
  • Experience designing slick, detailed, modern, forward-looking 3D character assets
  • Experienced in game art asset creation in a variety of software packages including Maya, 3ds Max, Zbrush, Photoshop, Substance, etc. Experience with the Unreal Engine is a plus
  • A strong portfolio that showcases an eye for modern fashion-forward aesthetics that speak to our audience of teens and young adults
  • A mind for technical function and aesthetic pursuit with an ability to balance creativity with function
  • Ability to work within gameplay design restraints (environment scale, character abilities, prototype function, etc.) and translate those restrictions into visuals that enhance the experience
  • Experience creating mechanical designs
  • Strong traditional drawing skills and knowledge of the human anatomy
  • Strong understanding of color theory and how color affects mood & focal points
  • Excellent verbal, written, and visual communication skills

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers, and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

Epic Games deeply values diverse teams and an inclusive work culture, and we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Learn more about our Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Policy here .

Note to Recruitment Agencies: Epic does not accept any unsolicited resumes or approaches from any unauthorized third party (including recruitment or placement agencies) (i.e., a third party with whom we do not have a negotiated and validly executed agreement). We will not pay any fees to any unauthorized third party. Further details on these matters can be found here .

Nosso propósito é transformar o futuro de cidades e pessoas, e pode ser o seu também!
Somos uma GovTech pioneira no desenvolvimento de sistemas inteligentes em nuvem para gestão pública no Brasil, focados na construção de cidades inteligentes. Fomos os primeiros da América Latina a desenvolver sistemas de gestão em cloud computing, considerando empresas públicas e privadas. Criamos ainda a primeira Inteligência Artificial para gestão pública, a Dara, que foi premiada duas vezes em 1° lugar como a melhor solução do Brasil para cidades inteligentes. Hoje, atuamos diariamente para transformar e descomplicar a gestão pública através do que há de melhor na tecnologia, com uma solução única e inteligente para gestão das cidades, seja na Contabilidade, na Saúde, na Educação, ou em mais de uma dezena de áreas.
A IPM é formada por mais de 600 pessoas apaixonadas pela inovação e transformação digital das cidades. Somos movidos por grandes desafios e pelo nosso impacto, e temos um sonho maior ainda: transformar o futuro de cidades e pessoas através do melhor da tecnologia.
Estamos crescendo Brasil afora, e sempre lançando novas soluções que estão transformando o futuro de pessoas e cidades. Nos últimos anos, conquistamos diversos prêmios e certificações da consultoria internacional Great Place to Work (GPTW). Em 2022, fomos reconhecidos como um dos 5 melhores times de RH do Brasil; em 2023, figuramos entre as melhores empresas para trabalhar pela segunda vez no ranking Mulher e pela primeira vez no ranking LGBTI+; e em 2024, recebemos pela 5ª vez consecutiva a certificação de uma das melhores empresas para trabalhar. Além disso, em 2024, alcançamos o 1º lugar nacional no Prêmio Connected Smart Cities, sendo premiados pela melhor solução para cidades inteligentes no Brasil.
Aqui, valorizamos a inovação, colaboração, sentimento de dono, foco no cliente, atitude descomplicada e ágil, e a mão-na-massa. Por isso, estamos sempre em busca de talentos tão motivados pelo nosso propósito e impacto quanto nós somos, que sejam apaixonados pela tecnologia, e que tenham muita garra para fazer acontecer.️
Venha construir o futuro da gestão pública na IPM!
Nessa Vaga, Seu Desafio Será

  • Fornecer suporte técnico em sistemas no ambiente interno do cliente, ajudando a solucionar dúvidas relacionadas ao software e garantindo que sua experiência de uso seja satisfatória;
  • Identificar e descrever possíveis melhorias para implementação do software;
  • Realizar abertura de chamados com base nas solicitações realizadas pelos usuários ou inconformidades identificadas no uso;
  • Realizar treinamento aos usuários do software, esclarecendo as dúvidas pontuais;
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre as tecnologias mais recentes, ferramentas do software e habilidades necessárias em sua área de atuação. Este profissional deve estar preparado para identificar e adotar novas abordagens para trabalhar com o software e ajudar os usuários a aprimorar sua operação e resultados através de nossas soluções, tornando as rotinas da gestão pública mais eficientes e inteligentes.
Requisitos
 Para essa posição, você vai precisar de:
  • Ensino superior completo ou em curso nas áreas de Ciências Contábeis, Administração, Tecnologia (Sistemas da Informação, Engenharia, Ciência da Computação, Gestão de TI, Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas, dentre outros), Engenharias ou áreas relacionadas;
  • Experiência com suporte de software ou implantação;
  • Será um diferencial ter conhecimento da legislação e vivência em rotinas tributárias na área pública (IPTU, ITBI, ISS, Dívida Ativa, Contribuição de Melhoria, dentre outras).
Benefícios
Benefícios Que Nosso Time Mais Gosta
  • Vale Refeição e/ou Alimentação (R$35 por dia de trabalho, em torno de R$735 ao mês) no cartão de benefícios flexível Caju;
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Wellhub (antigo Gympass) - acesso livre a mais de 50 mil academias pelo Brasil;
  • Psicologia Viva - plano de telepsicologia com uma consulta com psicólogo por mês sem custo;
  • Conexa Saúde - plataforma completa de telemecidina, com uma consulta de pronto atendimento por mês sem custo;
  • IPM Birthday - R$150,00 no Caju no mês do seu aniversário, para tornar o seu dia ainda mais especial;
  • IPM Indica - indicou um profissional, ele(a) passou no processo seletivo, você recebe o valor de R$ 500,00 de bonificação pela indicação;
  • Reconhece IPM - nosso reconhecimento financeiro por tempo de casa, investindo e buscando a construção de uma carreira duradoura conosco;
  • Rede de convênios para descontos, incluindo farmácias;
  • Convênio para plano de saúde Unimed;
  • Convênio para plano odontológico Uniodonto;
  • Plano de cargos e salários - aqui você tem a oportunidade real de crescer, e é reconhecido e valorizado pelo seu trabalho e desenvolvimento;
  • Programa de Integração: a pessoa responsável pela sua contratação, irá acompanhar você de perto por todo período de experiência;
  • Excelente cultura organizacional - somos reconhecidos como um excelente lugar para trabalhar pela consultoria internacional Great Place to Work (GPTW), sendo uma das 25 melhores empresas do Brasil para mulheres e uma das 3 melhores para LGBTI+;
  • Comemoração de datas comemorativas a cada mês - Janeiro Branco, CarnaFriday, Festa Junina, dentre outros;
  • Dress code flexível - nas nossas sedes físicas, você pode vir trabalhar de bermuda e camiseta;
  • E muito mais! Dia da Fruta, bicicletário, reconhecimento por conquistas individuais e de time, atuação na empresa líder em tecnologia para gestão pública...
Importante: Todas as nossas posições são abertas a pessoas com deficiência (PCD). Se os seus conhecimentos forem adequados à vaga, é tudo o que importa. Na IPM, nós abraçamos a diversidade e contratamos pessoas com capacidade e vontade de transformar, de construir um futuro melhor para a sociedade, independente de qual seja a sua idade, raça, cor, religião, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual ou formação. Seu perfil e valores casam com os nossos? Então venha fazer parte!

A Serasa Experian é a primeira e a maior Datatech do Brasil. Líder em soluções de inteligência para análise de riscos e oportunidades, com foco nas jornadas de crédito, autenticação e prevenção à fraude. Com tecnologia de ponta, inovação e os melhores talentos, transforma a incerteza do risco na melhor decisão, ajudando pessoas a realizarem seus sonhos e empresas de todos os portes e segmentos a prosperarem.
Temos 22.000 pessoas operando em 32 países e a cada dia estamos investindo em novas tecnologias, profissionais talentosos e inovação para ajudar todos os clientes a maximizarem cada oportunidade. Com sede corporativa em Dublin, Irlanda, a Experian está listada na Bolsa de Valores de Londres (EXPN) e compõe o índice FTSE 100.
Job Description
Buscamos um(a) Diretor(a) Comercial com perfil estratégico e visão de longo prazo para liderar o crescimento sustentável da companhia, consolidando a área comercial como um pilar fundamental na geração de valor. Sólida experiência no segmento multimarkets, para liderar a estratégia comercial em canais diversos. Esta liderança será responsável por impulsionar resultados de vendas, garantir crescimento sustentável e fortalecer o relacionamento com os canais indiretos, com foco em rentabilidade, cobertura de mercado e excelência na execução.
Qualifications
O que buscamos em você:

  • Formação superior completa em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Finanças ou áreas correlatas;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Sólida trajetória em posições executivas na liderança comercial;
  • Sólida experiência como Diretor ou Gerente Sênior comercial com atuação no segmento miltimarkets;
  • Vivência em gestão de canais indiretos: distribuidores, atacado, varejo, entre outros.
  • Visão estratégica aguçada, mentalidade analítica e foco em performance;
  • Capacidade de articulação institucional, negociação de alto nível e gestão de relacionamentos complexos;
  • Vivência com transformação digital, inovação em modelos de negócio e cultura orientada a dados será considerada um diferencial relevante.
Quais Serão Às Suas Principais Responsabilidades
  • Atuar como principal estrategista da área comercial, com profundo conhecimento do mercado, comportamento dos clientes e tendências do setor;
  • Definir, implementar e liderar a estratégia comercial da companhia, garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos corporativos e metas de crescimento sustentável;
  • Gerir e expandir a carteira de clientes, promovendo relacionamento de longo prazo e soluções customizadas que agreguem valor;
  • Monitorar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs), assegurando o atingimento de metas de vendas, rentabilidade e satisfação dos clientes;
  • Identificar e liderar oportunidades estratégicas de negócios, incluindo parcerias, fusões e aquisições que acelerem o crescimento da companhia;
  • Inspirar, desenvolver e liderar equipes de alta performance em ambiente desafiador e dinâmico;
  • Atuar em modelo matricial, integrando as metas da área comercial com os objetivos estratégicos das Unidades de Negócio;
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com times especialistas por produto, promovendo sinergia e foco na entrega de valor ao cliente.
Additional Information
Na Serasa Experian, acreditamos que a diversidade é fundamental para um ambiente de trabalho mais saudável e inovador, onde todas as pessoas possam trocar experiências e expressar suas ideias. Por isso, contamos com diversas ações para promover um recrutamento inclusivo e apoiar no desenvolvimento profissional das nossas pessoas. Além disso, temos os nossos grupos de afinidade, criados para empoderar e acolher as pessoas de grupos sub-representados:
ExperianPride (comunidade LGBTQIAPN+), Ubuntu (equidade racial), Women in Experian (equidade de gênero) e aspire (pessoas com deficiência) e Connecting Generations (gerações).

title: Closer de Vendas
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Closer de Vendas Sênior com sólida experiência no mercado de consórcios e ampla vivência no setor financeiro para integrar nossa equipe estratégica.

O(a) profissional será responsável por conduzir negociações complexas, atuar com vendas consultivas de alto valor agregado, realizar prospecção qualificada, gerir sua carteira de clientes com foco em fidelização, e contribuir ativamente para o crescimento estruturado da área comercial.

Esperamos um perfil com visão de negócios, capacidade analítica, autonomia na gestão do funil de vendas, domínio em CRM, e expertise em técnicas avançadas de negociação. A certificação PCA-10 é um diferencial essencial para a função.

O que você vai fazer:

1. Prospecção e Desenvolvimento de Negócios

• Realizar prospecção ativa e qualificada de novos clientes via networking, parcerias e canais digitais;

• Identificar oportunidades de negócio nos segmentos de consórcio (automóveis, imóveis, serviços);

• Desenvolver estratégias comerciais alinhadas ao planejamento da área.

2. Vendas Consultivas e Negociação

• Conduzir apresentações personalizadas, com foco nas necessidades do cliente;

• Realizar vendas consultivas com análise de perfil financeiro e objetivos do cliente;

• Negociar propostas comerciais e acompanhar o processo até a assinatura do contrato;

• Assegurar um atendimento consultivo e de excelência em todas as etapas da jornada.

3. Gestão de Carteira e Resultados

• Gerenciar carteira ativa, promovendo relacionamento contínuo com foco em fidelização;

• Trabalhar com metas mensais, indicadores de performance e qualidade no atendimento;

• Registrar e monitorar o funil de vendas através de ferramenta CRM.

4. Inteligência de Mercado e Colaboração

• Analisar tendências de mercado, comportamento do consumidor e práticas da concorrência;

• Propor melhorias nos processos e estratégias comerciais com foco em resultado;

• Participar de reuniões, treinamentos e eventos internos e externos para atualização contínua.

Formação acadêmica: Administração de empresas, Gestão comercial, Marketing ou áreas afins.

HArdskills desejáveis:

Habilidades com vendas de consórcio, Gestão de funil de vendas (pipeline); Utilização de CRM; Gestão de fidelização de carteira de clientes; Pacote Office Intermediário; Cerificação PCA-10 (Ativa); Leitura e interpretação de contratos de consórcio.

Em 2017, a Companhia realizou seu primeiro investimento ao adquirir o Vera Cruz Hospital, localizado na cidade de Campinas-SP, que, com mais de 80 anos de atuação, é um dos hospitais mais tradicionais da cidade. O hospital atualmente conta com 11 salas cirúrgicas, 120 leitos de internação, 30 leitos de UTI, maternidade e atendimento 24h. Senior Systems Analyst (IBM Power Systems)
 Position Summary:
The role of a Senior Systems Analyst with Netcracker is responsible for supporting the IBM Power Systems platforms within Netcracker's data centers. IBM Power Systems Platforms are made up of Development, Production, and Test Logical Partitions. The individual in this position will also assist in providing mentorship to our off-shore staff as needed. This position is part of our Global Managed Services (GMS) team that supports various Netcracker clients, located within North America and across the globe.
Role & Responsibilities:

  • Interact with Global Managed Services (GMS) customers on a daily basis in support of the environments managed by GMS – hosted or remote by
    • Resolving environment related problems reported by GMS customers through CSS as assigned
    • Completing service requests submitted by GMS customers, including managing customer user ids, remote print writers and/or queues, and similar requests
    • Submitting service requests for data center services needed by GMS customers
    • Acting as liaison between GMS customer and Netcracker IT Group to facilitate completion of requests
    • Researching system and database journals to retrieve auditing information in support of internal and customer data investigations
    • Troubleshooting problems with TCP/IP based interfaces using IBM and third party network tracing tools
  • Configure and monitor systems to ensure
    • peak and problem free operation
    • compliance with security standards
  • Configure and support
    • Software based replication, particularly using Vision Solutions MIMIX ha1, as it relates to both HA and DR implementations.
    • System monitoring, particularly using Help Systems Halcyon, especially as it relates to interface / job monitoring
    • Tape management systems, particularly using IBM's BRMS, especially as it relates to daily backup routines
    • System compliance and audit functions, particularly using Enforcive Enterprise Security, especially as it relates to PCI compliance
    • Automation functions, particularly using Help Systems Robot SCHEDULE and REPLAY, or IBM's Advanced Job Scheduler
    • Browser based GUI interface, particularly using Rocket Software's LegaSuite application over Netcracker's ICOMS solution.
    • Digital certificates using IBM Digital Certificate Manager
    • End user access to system tools using IBM i Navigator
  • Maintain application environments by
    • Reviewing patches and release updates and constructing a plan to apply them to Netcracker and third party applications
    • Creating custom programming using CL, RPG, or other available languages in support of production processing
    • Performing regular maintenance tasks in a timely manner to ensure PCI compliancy
  • Regularly review
    • Security bulletins issued by US-CERT, IBM, and other vendors, especially as they pertain to PCI compliance. Resolve any vulnerabilities in a timely manner
    • System performance statistics, forecasted growth data, and project system resource utilization, making recommendations for hardware and/or software upgrades to meet demand.
    • Disaster Recovery Plans and participate in annual Disaster Recovery Exercises, focusing on validating business continuity plans for GMS customers. Update the DR plans to reflect current configurations, environments, and processes.
  • Manage the underlying systems supporting the ICOMS solution by
    • Upgrading firmware, and HMC release levels in accordance with IBM compatibility matrices and recommendations
    • Allocating system resources for production and test partitions
    • Preparing system plans for partitions on Power Systems servers
    • Installing hardware components required by the solution
    • Reading the PAL and SAL in System Service Tools (SST) and Service logs in the HMC to assist hardware maintenance providers with troubleshooting, and resolving hardware problems.
  • Will be asked to perform similar duties for internal (development/test) systems as well.
  • May be asked to perform consulting services for customers outside of GMS
Required Skills & Experience:
  • Minimum of 5 years experience (preferably more) administering IBM i running on Power Systems servers.
    • Must be familiar with all aspects of system administration, including upgrades from previous releases, backup and recovery, storage management, using journaling, understands the differences between various types of ASPs and their uses, and has strong HMC skills.
  • IBM Certified System Administrator - IBM i 7.x (highly preferred)
  • At least one major system hardware upgrade (for example POWER6 to POWER7)
  • At least two major operating system upgrades (for example, IBM i 5.4 or 6.1 to 7.1)
  • At least two full system restores (as if from a site-down crash)
  • Experience in managing partitioned systems
  • Strong experience in using database journaling, especially remote journaling
  • Strong experience with utilizing Performance tools such as IBM Job Watcher/Pex and MPG Performance Navigator
  • Understands the differences between independent ASPs, *SYSBAS, and traditional ASPs
  • Understands the functional differences between logical replication and clustering
  • Understands IBM i security administration, compliance, and access control
  • Extensive knowledge of the HMC
  • Some experience managing IBM i with SAN-attached storage
  • Keeps up with IBM hardware announcements, and has an awareness of IBM technical directions for their product lines
  • Keeps up with Technology Refreshes, and has an awareness of new features and functions
  • Is very familiar with the IBM Memo to Users for V7R1 as of April 2012, and any subsequent Technical Releases (TRs)
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Ability to train operations monitoring staff on how to respond to alerts, ensure "switch readiness" on HA/DR systems, and perform less complex maintenance window activities
  • Must be able to provide 24x7 on-call support coverage - on a rotational basis with other team members. (on occasion)
Other Highly Desired Skills:
  • Experience installing software upgrades and updates to third party and in-house developed applications
  • Very familiar with the use of MIMIX software for logical replication of database information to redundant systems for high availability and disaster recovery deployments
  • Very familiar with the configuration and management of ODBC / JDBC / TCP socket communications on IBM i systems communicating with other applications running on Unix / Linux & or Windows systems
  • Very familiar with current PCI-DSS standards and how to ensure PCI compliance on IBM i operating system and database containing PCI sensitive data
  • Experience managing medium projects, lasting a few weeks, involving two or more teams.
  • Fluent English Speaker and availability to work from office on Hybrid mode
  • Must be able to work on Shifts mode

Uma história de mais de 60 anos de solidez e inovação.

Em 1961 foi fundado o Banco Sofisa, em uma jornada de transformação, adaptação e principalmente inovação.

Hoje, temos orgulho em ser um dos principais bancos do Brasil. O motivo disso é incentivar e acreditar no empreendedor brasileiro, fortalecendo relacionamentos apoiados na ética e no respeito. Um dos fatores que nos destacam no mercado é o comprometimento dos nossos colaboradores, com forte espírito empreendedor e uma paixão que os fazem vestir a camisa como se fossem donos. Por aqui, não nos contentamos com o status quo. Acreditamos que sempre podemos melhorar, aprender, investir e buscar o novo. A melhora contínua é um processo diário. Em toda a história, os negócios do Banco Sofisa foram construídos por uma sólida estrutura financeira, assegurada por altos índices de capitalização, fazendo com que os nossos clientes sintam-se seguros, investindo em ativos de qualidade, que muitas das vezes só se encontram por aqui.

Hoje, podemos dizer que vencemos o maior de todos os testes, o teste do tempo. E se esse teste foi vencido, é porque valorizamos quem realmente importa: você, nosso cliente. The INTech team builds International extensions and new features of the Amazon.com web site for individual countries and creates systems to support Amazon operations. We have already worked in Germany, France, UK, India, China, Italy, Brazil and more.
We operate as a startup within Amazon, providing great flexibility in product and technology direction. As a leader on the team, you will be expected to operate at all levels, diving deep into the details while providing strategic inputs for the product. You will be a key player in driving strategic planning, project execution, development of engineering talent, and the ongoing operation and improvement of the product.
You will establish and execute the long-term architectural road-map and drive continual improvements to the efficiency and flexibility of our product. You will hold the team to an extremely high bar for site performance, scalability and availability.
We have a very flat team structure, and offer an unique opportunity for technical leaders who want to work closely with the business in defining, designing, building and operating products that solve interesting business problems.
At Amazon Brazil we value Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DEI) in all our job positions, therefore, we act intentionally so that our internal environment reflects the plurality of the businesses we play and the customers we serve.
In Brazil, we have a Diversity, Equity and Inclusion squad, which is formed by representatives from different roles and areas, as we understand that this agenda must have different perspectives and multiple experiences. Our leadership is committed and understands more and more their role in sharing and acting on our leadership principles, with the purpose of ‘Strive to Be Earth's Best Employer’. Understanding our responsibility and our need for change, we are conscientious that ‘Success and Scale Bring Broad Responsibility’. Our affinity groups are built from and by volunteers from different businesses, and they are an active part of our DE&I strategies definition. Besides that, they act as ambassadors of this agenda, and they will support you from Day1. Remember, at Amazon ‘It’s always Day1’. Our groups are organized in the following fronts: BEN - Black Employee Network, , Glamazon (LGBTQIA+) and People With Disabilities.
Key job responsibilities
1. People Management
- Building and leading high-performing engineering teams
- Conducting performance reviews and career development discussions
- Mentoring and coaching engineers
- Handling hiring and team composition decisions
2. Technical Leadership
- Driving technical strategy and architecture decisions
- Ensuring technical excellence and best practices
- Reviewing and providing guidance on design documents
